items.text: Katonda n'aŋŋamba nti, "Tema mu jjinja ebipande bibiri eby'amayinja ebifaanana nga biri ebyasooka, era obajje n'Essanduuko ey'omuti, olyoke oyambuke gye ndi ku lusozi.
Nzija kuwandiika ku bipande ebyo ebigambo ebyali ku bipande ebyasooka, bye wayasa; olyoke obiteeke mu Ssanduuko."

Bwe ntyo ne mbajja Essanduuko mu muti ogw'akasiya, ne ntema ne mu jjinja ebipande bibiri eby'amayinja nga bifaanana nga biri ebyasooka, ne ndyoka nyambuka ku lusozi nga nkutte ebipande byombi mu ngalo zange.
Katonda n'awandiika ku bipande ebyo ebigambo bye yali awandiise ku bipande biri ebyasooka, ge Mateeka Ekkumi ge yali abalangiridde ku lusozi ng'ali wakati mu muliro, ku lunaku lwe mwakuŋŋaanirako.
Bwe ntyo ne nkyusa obuwufu ne nzikirira okuva ku lusozi, ebipande ne mbiteeka mu Ssanduuko gye nabajja, nga
Katonda bwe yandagira, ne kaakano mwe biri.

Abaana ba Isirayiri ne batambula okuva e Beeru Beneyaakani ne batuuka e Mosera. Awo Alooni we yafiira era we yaziikibwa. Mutabani we Eriyazaali n'amusikira n'atandika okukola emirimu gya Alooni egy'Obwakabona.
Bwe baava awo ne batambula okutuuka e Gudugoda; bwe baava e Gudugoda ne batuuka e Yotubasa, nga mu nsi eyo mulimu emigga egyali gikulukuta amazzi.
n'ayawula ekika kya Leevi okusitulanga Essanduuko ey'Endagaano ya
Katonda, n'okwatulanga emikisa gye mu linnya lye, nga bwe bakyakola n'okutuusa leero.
Noolwekyo Abaleevi tebaafuna mugabo wadde ekitundu eky'obusika mu nsi ensuubize nga baganda baabwe ab'ebika ebirala bwe baafuna; kubanga
Nabeerayo ku lusozi ne mmalayo ennaku amakumi ana, emisana n'ekiro, ng'omulundi guli ogwasooka. Ne ku mulundi guno
n'aŋŋamba nti, "Genda okulembere abantu, bakwate olugendo lwabwe, bayingire mu nsi gye nalayirira bajjajjaabwe okugibawa, bagyefunire."
Katonda wo, okutambuliranga mu makubo ge gonna, n'okumwagalanga, n'okuweerezanga
Katonda wo n'omutima gwo gwonna n'emmeeme yo yonna,
n'ebiragiro bye, nga bwe nkukuutira leero olw'obulungi bwo?
Katonda wo ye nannyini ggulu, era n'eggulu erisinga okuba waggulu ennyo nalyo lirye, n'ensi ne byonna ebigirimu.
yakwana bajjajjaabo n'abaagala nnyo, ne yeerondera mmwe, bazzukulu baabwe, okubeera ku ntikko y'amawanga gonna nga bwe kiri leero.
Noolwekyo mukomole emitima gyammwe, era mukomye okubeera n'amawagali.
Katonda wammwe ye Katonda wa bakatonda, era ye
w'abakama, ye Katonda omukulu, nannyini buyinza era Katonda atiibwa, atalina kyekubiira, era atalya nguzi.
Bamulekwa abataliiko bakitaabwe, ne bannamwandu, abamalira ensonga zaabwe mu bwenkanya; era ayagala ne bannamawanga abatambuze, ng'abawa emmere n'ebyokwambala.
Kale nno, mwagalenga bannamawanga kubanga nammwe mwaliko bannamawanga mu nsi ey'e Misiri.
Katonda wo era muweerezenga. Munywererengako, era mu linnya lye mw'onoolayiriranga.
Oyo, lye ttendo lyo era ye Katonda wo, eyakukolera ebyamagero ebyo byonna ebikulu ggwe kennyini bye weerabirako n'amaaso go.
Bajjajjaabo bwe baaserengeta e Misiri, bonna awamu baali bawera abantu nsanvu; kaakano
Katonda wo abafudde bangi nnyo ng'emmunyeenye ez'oku ggulu.

items.text: Katonda wo, ogonderenga ebigambo bye by'akukuutira, n'ebiragiro bye, n'amateeka ge ennaku zonna.
Mutegeere nga ku lunaku lwa leero soogera na baana bammwe abataamanya era abataalaba ku kukangavvula kwa
Katonda wammwe, n'ekitiibwa kye n'omukono gwe ogw'amaanyi, era ogw'obukuumi;
era abataalaba ku byamagero bye yakola n'ebintu byonna bye yakolera wakati mu Misiri, ku Falaawo, ye kabaka w'e Misiri n'eri ensi ye yonna;

ne bye yakola eggye lya Misiri n'embalaasi zaalyo n'amagaali gaalyo; era nga amaggye ago bwe yagazikiririza mu mazzi ag'omu Nnyanja Emyufu bwe gaali nga gabagoberera, n'agamalirawo ddala n'okutuusa leero.
Abaana bammwe si be baalaba ebyo byonna
bye yabakolera okuva nga muli mu ddungu n'okutuuka wano mu kifo kino,

era ne kye yakola Dasani ne Abiraamu batabani ba Eriyaabu, mutabani wa Lewubeeni, ettaka bwe lyayasamya akamwa kaalyo, wakati mu baana ba Isirayiri bonna, ne libamira n'ab'omu maka gaabwe bonna, n'eweema ez'ensiisira zaabwe zonna, ne buli kiramu kyabwe kyonna kye baalinako obwannannyini.
Naye mmwe bennyini mwe mwabiraba n'amaaso gammwe, ebintu ebyo ebikulu
Noolwekyo mukwatenga amateeka gonna ge mbalagira leero, mulyoke mubeere n'amaanyi okuyingira mu nsi gye mujja okwefunira, nga mumaze okusomoka omugga Yoludaani,
bwe mutyo mulyoke muwangaalenga nga muli mu nsi
gye yalayirira bajjajjammwe okugibawa awamu ne bazzukulu baabwe, ng'eyo ye nsi omukulukutira amata n'omubisi gw'enjuki.
Kubanga ensi gy'ogenda okuyingira, ogyefunire, tefaanaana ng'ensi y'e Misiri, gye mwava, gye wasimbanga ensigo zo n'ozifukiriranga n'ebbomba gye wasambyanga ekigere, ng'afukirira ennimiro y'enva.
Naye ensi gye mugenda okwefunira nga musomose omugga Yoludaani, ye nsi ey'ensozi n'ebiwonvu, enywa amazzi g'enkuba agava mu ggulu.
Katonda wo gabeera ku nsi eyo bulijjo, okuva ku ntandikwa y'omwaka okutuuka ku nkomerero yaagwo.
Bwe munaagonderanga amateeka gano ge mbalagira leero: okwagalanga
Katonda wammwe, n'okumuweerezanga n'omutima gwammwe gwonna, n'emmeeme yammwe yonna,
kale, anaatonnyesanga enkuba mu nsi yammwe mu biseera byayo: enkuba eya ddumbi n'eya ttoggo, olyoke okungulenga emmere yo ey'empeke, weefunire ne wayini omusu n'amafuta.
Era anaakuzanga omuddo mu malundiro go ente zo gwe zinaalyanga; naawe onoolyanga emmere n'okkuta.
Mwegenderezenga nnyo, mulemenga okukyama ne mubula, ne muweerezanga bakatonda abalala era ne mubavuunamiranga.
ne bubabuubuukirangako, n'aggalangawo eggulu, enkuba ne tetonnyanga, n'ettaka ne litabalangako bibala, ne muzikiriranga ne muggwaawo mangu ku nsi ennungi
Kale muterekenga ebigambo byange bino mu mutima gwammwe ne mu mmeeme yammwe; munaabisibanga ku mikono gyammwe ng'akabonero ak'okubibajjukizanga, era mubitekanga ne ku byenyi byammwe.
Mubiyigirizenga abaana bammwe, ng'obinyumyako bw'onoobanga otudde mu nnyumba yo, ne bw'onoobanga otambula mu nguudo; ne bw'onoogalamirangako, era ne bw'onoositukanga.
Era onoobiwandiikanga ku myango ne ku nzigi,
mmwe n'abaana bammwe mulyoke muwangaalenga nnyo, mumale ennaku nnyingi nga ebbanga eggulu lye lirimala nga liri waggulu w'ensi, nga muli mu nsi
Bwe muneegenderezanga, ne mugonderanga ebiragiro bino byonna bye mbawa okubikolanga: kwe kwagalanga
Katonda wammwe, n'okutambuliranga mu makubo ge gonna, n'okumunywererangako;
anaagobangamu amawanga ago gonna aganaabanga mu maaso gammwe, ne mwefunira ensi z'amawanga ago agabasinga mmwe obunene era n'amaanyi.
Buli we munaalinnyanga ekigere kyammwe, ekifo ekyo kinaabeeranga kyammwe; okuva ku ddungu okutuuka ku Lebanooni, n'okuva ku Mugga Fulaati okutuuka ku nnyanja ey'ebugwanjuba.
Katonda wammwe aliteeka entiisa n'ekikangabwa mu bannansi bonna, buli we munaagendanga, nga bwe yabasuubiza.
Mulabe, ku lunaku lwa leero nteeka mu maaso gammwe omukisa n'ekikolimo.
Katonda wammwe, ne mukyamanga okuva mu kkubo lye mbalagira leero, ne mugobereranga bakatonda abalala be mwali mutamanyi.
Katonda wo bw'alikutuusa mu nsi gy'ogenda okuyingiramu ogyetwalire ng'obutaka bwo obw'enkalakkalira, omukisa oguteekanga ku lusozi Gerizimu, n'ekikolimo ku lusozi Ebali.

Ensozi ezo ziri mitala wa Yoludaani ku ludda olw'ebugwanjuba obw'oluguudo ng'oyolekedde enjuba gy'egwa, okumpi n'emiti eminene egy'e Mole, mu nsi y'Abakanani ababeera mu Alaba ku miriraano gya Girugaali.
Muli kumpi okusomoka omugga Yoludaani mwefunire ensi
Katonda wammwe gy'abawa. Bwe mulimala okugyetwalira, nga mwe mubeera,
mwegenderezenga nnyo mugonderenga amateeka gonna, n'ebiragiro bye nteeka mu maaso gammwe leero.

items.text: Gano ge mateeka n'ebiragiro bye musaana okukwatanga n'obwegendereza, nga muli mu nsi
Katonda wa bajjajjaabo gy'akuwadde okubeera obutaka bwo ebbanga lyonna lye mulimala ku nsi.
Muzikiririzanga ddala ebifo byonna ebiri ku gasozi ne ku nsozi, ne wansi w'agati aganene,

bannaggwanga be mugenda okutwalako ensi yaabwe gye basinziza; n'amayinja gaabwe mugaasaayasanga, n'empagi zaabwe eza Asera mulizimenyaamenya ne muzookya mu muliro; n'ebibajje ebya bakatonda baabwe mubitemaatemanga n'amannya gaabwe mu bifo ebyo ne mugasanguliramu ddala.
Katonda wammwe, ye temumusinzanga mu ngeri eyo nga bali bwe bakola.
Mmwe munoonyanga mu bika byammwe byonna, ekifo
Katonda wammwe ky'alibalondera we munaateekanga Erinnya lye ne mumuzimbira awo ennyumba ye ey'okubeerangamu. Mu kifo ekyo gye munaagendanga okumusinza;

awo we munaaleetanga ebiweebwayo byammwe ebyokebwa ne biweebwayo ebirala, n'ebitundu byammwe eby'ekkumi, n'ebirabo eby'enjawulo, n'obweyamo bwammwe, n'ebiweebwayo ebya kyeyagalire, n'ebibereberye eby'omu bisibo byammwe n'eby'omu biraalo byammwe.
Mmwe n'ab'omu nnyumba zammwe munaaliiranga mu maaso ga
Katonda wammwe, munaasanyukanga ne mwenyumirizanga mu buli kintu kyonna kye munaabanga mukoze n'emikono gyammwe, kubanga
Temukolanga nga bwe tukola wano leero, nga buli omu akola nga bw'alaba ekisaanidde,
kubanga temunnatuuka mu kiwummulo ne mu busika
Naye bwe mulimala okusomoka omugga Yoludaani, ne mubeera mu nsi
Katonda wammwe gy'abawa nga bwe busika bwammwe, ng'abawadde n'okuwummula, nga temukyataataaganyizibwa balabe bammwe abanaabanga babeetoolodde n'okutuula ne mutuulanga mu mirembe;

Katonda wammwe kyanaabanga yeerondedde okutuuzanga omwo Erinnya lye, omwo mwe munaaleetanga buli kintu kyonna kye mbalagira: ebiweebwayo byammwe ebyokebwa, n'ebiweebwayo ebirala, n'ebitundu byammwe eby'ekkumi, n'ebirabo eby'enjawulo, n'ebirabo ebisinga obulungi mu bintu byammwe bye munaabanga mweyamye okuwaayo eri

Katonda wammwe, mmwe, ne batabani bammwe, ne bawala bammwe, n'abaweereza bammwe abasajja, n'abaweereza bammwe abakazi, n'Abaleevi ab'omu bibuga byammwe, kubanga bo ku bwabwe tebalifuna mugabo oba obusika okufaanana nga mmwe.
Weekuumanga n'otaweerayo biweebwayo by'omu buli kifo kyonna ky'onoolabanga.
Obiweerengayo mu kifo ekyo ekimu kyokka
ky'anaakulonderanga okuva mu kimu ku bika byo; era omwo mw'onookoleranga ebyo byonna bye nkulagira.
Ebiragiro ku Biweebwayo ebitali bya bulijjo
Naye onettiranga ku bisolo ebinaabanga mu bibuga byo, oba mpeewo oba njaza, n'olya ennyama nnyingi nga bw'onooyagalanga, ng'omukisa bwe guli
Katonda wo gw'anaakuwanga. Abalongoofu mu by'emikolo n'abatali balongoofu, bonna banaalyanga.
Wabula omusaayi temugulyanga; munaaguyiwanga wansi ku ttaka ng'amazzi.

Mu bibuga byo toliirangamu kitundu ekimu eky'ekkumi eky'emmere yo ey'empeke, oba ekya wayini wo, oba eky'amafuta go; oba ebibereberye eby'omu bisibo byo n'eby'omu biraalo byo, oba n'obweyamo bwo oba n'ebiweebwayo ebya kyeyagalire; wadde n'ebirabo ebitali bya bulijjo.
Katonda wo ky'anaabanga akulondedde; ggwe, ne mutabani wo, ne muwala wo, n'omuweereza wo omusajja n'omuweereza wo omukazi, n'Omuleevi anaabanga mu bibuga byo, era onoosanyukiranga mu maaso ga
Katonda wo mu buli kintu kyonna ky'onoobanga okoze n'emikono gyo.
Weekuumanga nnyo obutalagajjaliranga Muleevi ebbanga lyonna ly'olimala ng'oli mulamu ku nsi.
Katonda wo bw'aligaziya amatwale go, nga bwe yakusuubiza, n'oyoyanga okulya ku nnyama ng'ogamba nti, "Nandiyagadde okulya ku nnyama." Kale, onoolyanga ennyama ennyingi nga bw'onooyagalanga.
Katonda wo ky'anaabanga akulondedde okuteekamu Erinnya lye, bwe kinaabanga kiri wala n'ewuwo kale onooyinzanga okutta ku zimu ku nsolo ez'omu bisibo byo ne mu biraalo byo
by'anaabanga akuwadde, nga bwe nkulagidde; era mu bibuga byo onooyinzanga okulya ennyama ennyingi nga bw'onooyagalanga.
Onoogiryanga nga bw'onoolyanga empeewo n'enjaza. Abalongoofu n'abatali balongoofu bonna banaalyanga.
Naye weekuumenga obutalyanga musaayi; kubanga omusaayi bwe bulamu, ate nga tekikugwaniranga kulyanga bulamu ng'olya ennyama.
Togulyanga; oguyiwanga wansi ku ttaka ng'amazzi.
Togulyanga, olyoke obeerenga mu ddembe, ggwe, n'abaana bo, ng'okoze ebituufu mu maaso ga
Naye ebintu byo ebitukuvu ne byonna by'oneeyamanga okuwaayo, onoobiddiranga n'obitwalanga mu kifo
Onooleetanga ebiweebwayo byo ebyokebwa, ennyama n'omusaayi, ku Kyoto kya
Katonda wo. Omusaayi gw'ebiweebwayo byo ebirala gunaafukibwanga ku Kyoto kya
Katonda wo, naye ennyama onooyinzanga okugirya.
Weegenderezenga okugoberera ebiragiro bino byonna bye nkuwa, olyoke obeenga bulungi, ggwe, n'abaana bo, oluvannyuma lwo, emirembe gyonna, kubanga onoobanga okoze ekituufu mu maaso ga
Amawanga ago g'ogenda okulumba ogatwaleko ensi yaabwe,
agenda kugazikiriza nga naawe olaba. Naye bw'obanga omaze okubagoba mu nsi yaabwe, n'okugibeeramu n'ogibeeramu,

era ng'amawanga ago gamaze okuzikirizibwa nga naawe olaba, weekuumanga n'otabuuliriza ku bya bakatonda baabwe ng'ogamba nti, "Ab'omu mawanga ago baasinzanga batya bakatonda baabwe, nange njagala nkole bwe ntyo?"
Katonda wo tomusinzanga mu ngeri efaanana ng'eya bali, kubanga mu kusinza bakatonda baabwe bakoleramu ebikolobero bingi
by'atayagala, by'akyawa. Bayokya ne batabani baabwe ne bawala baabwe mu muliro nga ssaddaaka eri bakatonda baabwe.
Kibagwanidde okunyiikiranga okukolanga buli kintu kye mbalagira, tokyongerangako wadde okukikendeezangako.

items.text: Mu mmwe bwe mulabikangamu nnabbi oba omuntu n'akutegeeza eby'omu maaso nga yeeyambisa ebirooto, n'alangirira ebyamagero oba ebyewuunyisa ebijja okubeerawo,
era ebyamagero ebyo, oba ebyewuunyisa ebyo by'anaabanga alangiridde ne bituukirira, n'alyoka akugamba nti, "Ka tugoberere bakatonda abalala era tubaweerezenga" (bakatonda ggwe b'otomanyangako),
towulirizanga bigambo bya nnabbi oyo, oba omuloosi w'ebirooto oyo. Kubanga
Katonda wammwe anaabanga abagezesa bugezesa ategeere obanga munaabanga mumwagala n'omutima gwammwe gwonna n'emmeeme yammwe yonna.

Katonda wammwe gwe munaagobereranga, era ye yekka gwe munaatyanga, era amateeka ge, ge munaakwatanga, era n'eddoboozi lye, lye munaawulirizanga era lye munaagonderanga, era ku ye kwe munaanywereranga.
Kale nno nnabbi oyo, oba omuloosi w'ebirooto oyo anattibwanga, kubanga anaabanga abasasamaza mujeemere
Katonda wammwe, eyabaggya mu nsi ey'e Misiri, n'abanunula mu nnyumba ey'obuddu, nnabbi oyo ng'akusasamaza, ove mu kkubo ettuufu
Katonda wo lye yakulagira okutambulirangamu. Bw'otyo ekibi ekiri mu mmwe, bw'onookimalangamu.

Omuntu yenna, ne bw'abanga muganda wo oba mutabani wo, oba muwala wo, oba mukazi wo omuganzi ennyo, oba mukwano gwo gw'oyagala ennyo ow'okulusegere, n'akusendasendanga mu kyama ng'agamba nti, "Jjangu tugende tusinze bakatonda abalala," bakatonda ggwe b'otomanyangako, ne bakadde bo be batamanyangako,
bakatonda ab'abantu ababeetoolodde, ab'oku muliraano, oba abeewala, okuva ensi gy'etandikira ne gy'ekoma,
tomuwulirizanga, so by'anaakugambanga tobikolanga. Tomusaasiranga era tomuzibiikirizanga wadde okumusonyiwanga.
Omuttiranga ddala. Gw'omusokangako ng'attibwa n'abantu bonna ne bassa okwo.
Onoomukubanga amayinja n'omutta, kubanga anaabanga agezezzaako okukukyusa akuggye ku
Katonda wo eyakuggya mu nsi ey'e Misiri mu nnyumba ey'obuddu.
Kale Isirayiri yonna banaakiwuliranga banaatyanga, era tewaabeerengawo mu mmwe n'omu anaddangayo okukola ekibi ng'ekyo.
nga mulimu abantu abali mu mmwe abasituse ne basikiriza abantu b'omu kibuga kyabwe ekyo nga babagamba nti, "Ka tugende tusinze bakatonda abalala," bakatonda be mutamanyangako,
kale nno kikusaanira obuulirizenga nnyo ku kintu ekyo, okyekebejjenga, okyekkaanyizenga ddala. Bwe kinaakakasibwanga nga kya mazima, nga wakati mu mmwe waliwo abakoze ekintu ekibi bwe kityo,
kale, abantu bonna abanaabeeranga mu kibuga onoobattanga n'ekitala, awamu n'ebisolo byabwe bye balunda byonna.
Omunyago gwonna onoogukuŋŋaanyizanga wakati mu kibangirizi eky'omu kibuga, era onooyokyanga ekibuga kyonna n'omunyago gwako n'omuliro, ng'ekiweebwayo ekiri awamu ekyokebwa eri
Katonda wo. Ekibuga ekyo kinaasigalanga awo nga kifunvu eky'olubeerera, tekiddibwengamu kuzimbibwa.
Tewaabeerengawo kintu na kimu ku ebyo ebinaabanga bimaze okukolimirwa ky'onoosangibwanga nakyo, bwe butyo obusungu bwa
obunaabanga obungi ennyo bunakkakkananga; anaakukwatirwanga ekisa, n'akulaganga okwagala kwe, n'akwongeranga okwala, nga bwe yalayirira bajjajjaabo,
Katonda wo n'okwatanga amateeka ge gonna ge nkuwa leero, n'okolanga ebisaanidde mu maaso ga

items.text: Katonda wammwe. Temwesalangako misale oba enjola ku mibiri gyammwe, wadde okwemwangako enviiri ez'omu bwenyi nga mufiiriddwa
Katonda wo. Mu mawanga gonna ag'oku nsi,
ggwe gwe yalondamu okuba eggwanga lye eddonde lye yeefunira.
Temulyanga nnyama ya kisolo kyonna ekitali kirongoofu eky'omuzizo.
Bino bye bisolo bye munaalyanga: ente, endiga, embuzi,
enjaza, empeewo, ennangaazi, embulabuzi, entamu, enteŋŋo n'endiga ez'omu nsiko.
Era munaayinzanga okulya ensolo ezirina ebinuulo ebyawulamu wabiri nga zizza n'obwenkulumu.

Naye nno ku ezo ezirina ebinuulo ebyawulamu oba nga zizza obwenkulumu, zino temuziryanga: eŋŋamira, akamyu, n'omusu. Kubanga newaakubadde nga zizza obwenkulumu, ekinuulo kyazo sikyawulemu, si nnongoofu za muzizo gye muli.

Embizzi nazo si nnongoofu, kubanga newaakubadde zirina ekinuulo ekyawulemu, naye tezizza bwenkulumu, noolwekyo zinaabanga za muzizo gye muli. Ennyama yaazo temugiryanga so temukwatanga wadde okukoma ku mirambo gyazo.
Mu biramu ebibeera mu mazzi, munaalyanga ebyo ebirina amaggwa ku mugongo n'amagalagamba.
Naye ebyo byonna ebitalina maggwa na magalagamba temubiryanga, kubanga si birongoofu gye muli.
Naye zino temuuziryenga: empungu, ennunda, makwanzi,
ne maaya, n'olubugabuga, olusove, enkambo n'ekika kyazo,
ne kasiida, ne ssekanyolya, n'ekika kye, n'ekkookootezi, n'ekinyira.
Ebiwuka byonna ebirina ebiwaawaatiro nga bigendera mu kibinja si birongoofu gye muli, temuubiryenga.
Ekiramu kyonna ekirongoofu ekirina ebiwaawaatiro munaayinzanga okukirya.

Ekintu kyonna kye munaasanganga nga kimaze okufa, temukiryanga. Onooyinzanga okukiwanga munnaggwanga anaabeeranga mu bibuga byo ye n'akirya, oba onooyinzanga okukitunzanga munnaggwanga. Kubanga oli ggwanga ettukuvu eri
Tofumbiranga kabuzi kato mu mata ga nnyina waako.
Buli lw'onookungulanga ebibala byo nga biva mu nnimiro yo buli mwaka, weegenderezanga n'ossangako wabbali ekitundu kyabyo eky'ekkumi.
Onoolyanga ekitundu eky'ekkumi eky'emmere y'empeke, n'ekya wayini omusu, n'eky'amafuta, n'eky'ebibereberye eby'ebisibo byo n'eby'amagana go. Onookiriiranga mu maaso ga
Katonda wo mu kifo ky'anaabanga yeerondedde eky'okubeerangamu Erinnya lye, olyokenga oyige okutyanga
ng'akuwadde omukisa, kyokka ng'ekifo ekyo kye yeerondera okubeerangamu Erinnya lye kiri wala n'ewuwo, noolwekyo nga toosobolenga kwetikka ekitundu eky'ekkumi okukituusangayo,
kale nno, onookiwaanyisangamu omuwendo gw'ensimbi. Onoogendanga n'ensimbi ezo ng'ozinywezezza mu mukono gwo mu kifo

Ensimbi ezo onoozeegulirangamu ekintu kyonna ky'onooyagalanga: gamba ente, oba endiga, oba envinnyo, oba ekyokunywa ekitamiiza, oba ekintu kyonna ky'onooyagalanga. Ggwe awamu n'ab'omu maka go bonna munaaliiranga awo mu maaso ga
Naye nno, Omuleevi anaabeeranga naawe mu bibuga byo tomulagajjaliranga, kubanga ye talina mugabo wadde ebyobusika ebibye ku bubwe nga ggwe.
Buli myaka esatu, ku buli nkomerero ya mwaka ogwokusatu, onooleetanga ebitundu eby'ekkumi byonna ebyo eby'ebibala byo byonna eby'omwaka ogwo, n'obiterekanga mu mawanika mu bibuga byo.

Kale nno, Omuleevi kubanga taabenga na mugabo wadde ebyobusika nga ggwe, ne bamulekwa abatalina bakitaabwe ne nnamwandu; abo bonna abanaabanga babeera mu bibuga byo, bajjenga balye okutuusa lwe banakkutanga; bw'atyo
Katonda wo alyoke akuwenga omukisa mu buli kimu kyonna ky'onookolanga n'emikono gyo.

items.text: Ku buli nkomerero y'omwaka ogw'omusanvu, amabanja gonna onoogasonyiwanga.
Okusonyiwa okwo kunaabeeranga bwe kuti: buli muntu eyawola munne ebbanja, anaasazangamu ebbanja eryo lye yamuwola. Temubanjanga Bayisirayiri bannammwe, kubanga ebiro
by'anaabanga ataddewo eby'okusonyiwagana amabanja binaabanga bimaze okulangirirwa.
, naye ebbanja muganda wo ly'akulinako onoolimusonyiwanga.
Naye tewaabeerengawo mwavu mu mmwe kubanga ng'otuuse mu nsi
Katonda wo gy'akuwa okugyefunira ng'obutaka bwo obw'enkalakkalira n'akuyiwangako emikisa gye emingi,
Katonda wo, n'ogoberera n'obwegendereza ebiragiro bino byonna bye nkuwa leero.
Katonda wo agenda kukuyiwako emikisa gye nga bwe yakusuubiza. Amawanga mangi onoogawolanga naye ggwe tojjanga kugeewolako. Onoofuganga amawanga mangi, naye go tegaakufugenga.
Bw'onoobanga oli mu bibuga by'omu nsi
Katonda wo gy'akuwa, mu mmwe bwe munaabangamu munno omwavu ali mu kwetaaga tokakanyazanga mutima gwo wadde okukodowaliranga muganda wo oyo omwavu.
Omwanjululizanga engalo zo, n'omuwolanga n'okwagala kyonna ky'anaabanga yeetaaga okumuwewulako obuzibu bwe.

Weekuumenga nnyo olemenga kubeeranga na ndowooza eno embi mu mutima gwo nti, "Omwaka ogw'omusanvu ogw'okusonyiwa amabanja gusembedde," muganda wo n'omukwatirwa ettima n'otobaako ky'omuwa. Muganda wo ayinza okujulira eri
Muwenga n'okwagala n'obutajuliriranga, kubanga olw'omwoyo ng'ogwo,
Katonda wo ajjanga kukuwanga omukisa mu mirimu gyo gyonna, ne mu buli kintu ky'onootuusangako engalo zo.
Olwokubanga mu nsi temuubulengamu baavu abali mu kwetaaga, kyenva nkulagira nti muganda wo omwavu era ali mu kwetaaga omwanjululizanga engalo zo bulijjo mu nsi yo.
Omusajja Omwebbulaniya oba omukazi Omwebbulaniya gw'onoobanga oguze okukuweerezanga, bw'anaamalangako emyaka omukaaga, mu mwaka ogw'omusanvu onoomuddizanga eddembe lye.
Omuwangako, nga teweebalira, ku magana go, ne ku mmere yo ey'empeke, ne ku wayini wo. Omuwanga nga
Ojjukiranga nga wali muddu mu nsi y'e Misiri,
Katonda wo n'akununulayo. Noolwekyo kyenva nkuwa ekiragiro kino leero.
Naye omuddu bw'anaakugambanga nti, "Sijja kuva wano," kubanga akwagala nnyo ggwe n'abali mu maka go, era nga bw'abeera naawe aba bulungi;
kale nno, onoomulazanga awali oluggi, n'oddira olukato n'olufumitanga
mu kutu kwe okw'ebweru ne luyingira ne mu luggi; olwo anaabanga afuuse muweereza wo ennaku zonna ez'obulamu bwe bwonna. N'omuweereza wo omukazi naye onoomuyisanga bw'otyo.
Tolowoozanga nti omukwatiddwa ekisa kubanga akuweerezza okumala emyaka mukaaga, nga buli mulimu gw'akola gwandikoleddwanga abaweereza ab'empeera babiri balamba. Era mu byonna by'onookolanga,
Buli bibereberye ebisajja ebinaazaalibwanga mu ggana lyo ne mu kisibo kyo, onoobitukuzanga era binaabanga bya
Katonda wo. Ente zo ennume embereberye tozikozesanga mirimu, n'endiga zo embereberye tozisalangako byoya.
Ebibereberye ebyo onoobiryanga buli mwaka, buli mwaka, ggwe n'ab'omu nju yo bonna, nga mubiriiranga mu maaso ga
Ekisolo bwe kinaabeerangako akamogo, gamba nga kirema, oba nga kizibe kya maaso, oba nga kiriko ekikyamu kyonna ekinene, tokireetanga ng'ekiweebwayo eri
Onookiriiranga mu bibuga byo. Omulongoofu n'atali mulongoofu mwenna munaabiryanga nga bwe munaalyanga empeewo oba enjaza.
Naye omusaayi togulyanga, oguyiwanga wansi ku ttaka ng'ayiwa amazzi.

items.text: Ojjukiranga omwezi ogwa Abibu ng'ogukwatiramu Okuyitako kwa
Katonda wo, kubanga ekiro mu mwezi gwa Abibu,
Katonda wo mwe yakuggyira mu nsi y'e Misiri.
eky'Okuyitako, ng'okiggya mu ggana lyo, ne mu kisibo kyo mu kifo
ky'anaabanga yerondedde nga kye ky'okubeerangamu Erinnya lye.

Tokiryanga na mugaati omuzimbulukuse. Onoomalanga ennaku musanvu ng'emigaati gy'olya si mizimbulukuse, gye migaati egy'okulaba ennaku, kubanga mu Misiri wavaayo mu bwangu, bw'otyo olyokenga ojjukirenga, mu nnaku zonna ez'obulamu bwo, olunaku lwe wasitulirako ng'ova mu nsi y'e Misiri.

Tewaabeerengawo asangibwa na kizimbulukusa mu nsi yo yonna okumalanga ennaku musanvu. Ennyama gy'onooteekateekanga, ey'ekiweebwayo, akawungeezi ku lunaku olw'olubereberye teesigalengawo kutuusa nkeera.
ky'anaabanga yeerondedde eky'okubeerangamu Erinnya lye. Eyo gy'onooweerangayo Okuyitako akawungeezi ng'enjuba egwa, ng'ojjukiranga olunaku lwe wasitulirako ng'ova mu nsi y'e Misiri.
Onoofumbanga okuyitako okwo n'okuliira mu kifo
Katonda wo kye yeerondera. Enkeera onoddangayo mu weema yo.
Onoolyanga emigaati egitali mizimbulukuse okumala ennaku mukaaga, kyokka ku lunaku olw'omusanvu kunaabanga kukuŋŋaana mu maaso ga
Katonda wo okumusinza; tolukolerangako mulimu gwonna.
Onoobalanga wiiki musanvu okuva ku kiseera lw'onookungulanga emmere ey'empeke okuva mu nnimiro yo omulundi ogusooka.
Kale nno onookwatanga Embaga ya Wiiki ezo ng'oleetera
Katonda wo ekiweebwayo ekya kyeyagalire ekinaavanga mu ngalo zo, ng'emikisa bwe ginaabeeranga

Katonda wo mu kifo ky'anaabanga yeerondedde okubeerangamu Erinnya lye. Onoosanyukanga ne batabani bo, ne bawala bo, n'abaweereza bo abasajja, n'abaweereza bo abakazi, n'Omuleevi anaabeeranga mu bibuga byo, ne munnaggwanga ne mulekwa, ne nnamwandu abanaabeeranga mu mmwe.
Ojjukiranga nga bwe wali omuddu mu nsi ey'e Misiri, osaana ogonderenga ebiragiro ebyo n'obwegendereza.
Onookwatanga Embaga ey'Ensiisira okumala ennaku musanvu ng'omaze okuyingiza ebyamakungula byo okubiggya mu gguuliro, ne wayini ng'omuggye mu ssogolero lyo.

Onoojaguzanga ng'oli ku Mbaga eyo, ggwe, ne mutabani wo, ne muwala wo, n'omuweereza wo omusajja, n'omuweereza wo omukazi, n'Omuleevi, n'omunnaggwanga, ne mulekwa, ne nnamwandu, abanaabeeranga mu bibuga byo.
Onoomalanga ennaku musanvu ng'ojaguza ku Mbaga eyo mu maaso ga
Katonda wo anaakuwanga omukisa mu bibala byonna eby'amakungula go, ne mu mirimu gyo gyonna gy'onootuusangako engalo zo, essanyu lyo bwe lityo linaabanga lijjuvu.
Abasajja bonna mu mmwe banaakuŋŋaananga emirundi esatu buli mwaka, mu maaso ga
Katonda wo, mu kifo ky'aneeronderanga, ku Mbaga y'Emigaati Egitali Mizimbulukuse, ne ku Mbaga eya Wiiki Omusanvu, ne ku Mbaga ey'Ensiisira. Tewaabengawo n'omu anajjanga engalo enjereere awali
Buli omu anaaleetanga ekirabo kye ng'obusobozi bwe bwe bunaabanga, nga bwesigamizibwa ku mikisa
Onoolondanga abalamuzi n'abakulembeze mu bantu, mu bika byo byonna, mu bibuga byo byonna,
Katonda wo by'akuwa, baweerezenga abantu nga babasalirawo ensonga zaabwe nga tebasaliriza.
Obeeranga n'obwenkanya, era tobanga na kyekubiira ng'osala emisango. Tolyanga nguzi, kubanga enguzi eziba amaaso g'omugezi era ebuzaabuza ebigambo by'abatuukirivu.
Ogobereranga bwenkanya bwokka olyoke olye ensi
Tosimbanga miti gya kusinza okumpi n'ekyoto ky'onoozimbiranga
wadde okuyimirizangawo empagi ey'amayinja ey'okusinzanga; kubanga ebyo byonna

items.text: Katonda wo eky'ente oba eky'endiga ng'eriko akamogo oba ekikyamu kyonna, kubanga ebiri ng'ebyo Katonda wo abikyayira ddala.
Omuntu yenna omusajja oba omukazi abeera mu mmwe, mu kimu ku bibuga
Katonda wo by'akuwa, bw'anaakwatibwanga ng'akoze ebibi mu maaso ga
era ng'ajeemedde ekiragiro kyange n'asinza bakatonda abalala, ng'enjuba, oba omwezi, oba emmunyeenye ez'oku ggulu, bye siragiranga okubisinzanga,
ekikolwa ekyo ne kikutegeezebwangako; kale onookinoonyerezangako n'obwegendereza. Bwe kinaakakasibwanga nga kya mazima, ng'ekibi ekyo kikoleddwa mu Isirayiri,
onoofulumyanga omusajja oyo, oba omukazi oyo, akoze ekibi ekyo, wabweru wa wankaaki w'ekibuga n'omukuba amayinja, n'afa.
Omuntu anattibwanga nga wamaze kulabikawo obujulizi bw'abantu babiri oba basatu, naye omuntu tattibwenga ku bujulizi bw'omuntu omu yekka.
Abajulizi be banaasookanga okukasuukirira omuntu oyo amayinja, n'abalala ne bagoberera. Kinaakusaaniranga okwemalangako ebibi ebinaabeeranga wakati mu mmwe.

Bwe wanaabangawo emisango egireeteddwa mu mbuga yo nga mizibu gikukaluubiridde okusala, oba nga gya kuyiwa musaayi, oba gya kuwozaŋŋanya, oba kukubagana, oba ensonga endala zonna ezinaabangamu enkaayana mu bibuga byo, ensonga ezo zonna onoozitwalanga mu kifo
Bw'onootuukanga eyo oneebuuzanga ku bakabona, be Baleevi, ne ku mulamuzi anaabanga akola omulimu ogwo mu kiseera ekyo. Banaakutegeezanga ensala yaabwe.
Onookoleranga ku nsala yaabwe eyo gye banaakuwanga mu kifo ekyo
ky'anaabanga yeerondedde. Weegenderezanga nnyo n'okola ebyo bye banaabanga bakulagidde.

Kinaakugwaniranga okukola ng'amateeka ge banaabanga bakunnyonnyodde bwe gagamba, n'ensala yaabwe nga bw'eneebanga gye banaakutegeezanga. Bye banaakutegeezanga tobivangako kulaga ku mukono ogwa ddyo oba ku gwa kkono.
Omuntu yenna anaanyoomanga omulamuzi oba kabona eyateekebwawo okuweereza
Katonda wo, omuntu oyo wa kufa. Bw'otyo bw'onoomalangamu ekibi mu Isirayiri.
Abantu bonna banaabiwuliranga ne batya, ne bataddayo nate kukola bya kyejo.
Katonda wo gy'akuwa, n'ogirya, n'obeera omwo, oliyinza okugamba nti, "Leka neeteekerewo kabaka ananfuganga okufaanana ng'amawanga amalala gonna aganneebunguludde;"
Katonda wo gw'anaakulonderanga. Kikugwanira okumuggyanga mu bantu bo bennyini. Tokkirizibwenga kwessizangawo kabaka omunnaggwanga anaabanga tavudde mu baganda bo bennyini, okukufuganga.
Kabaka oyo tateekwa kwefuniranga mbalaasi nnyingi, wadde okutumanga abantu mu Misiri bamufunirengayo embalaasi endala okwongeranga ku z'alina obungi; kubanga
Tawasanga bakazi bangi kubanga bagenda kumukyamyanga. So tekimugwanira kwetuumangako zaabu n'effeeza ennyingi ennyo.
Bw'anaamalanga okutebenkera ku ntebe ey'obwakabaka bwe, anaakoppololeranga amateeka gano mu kitabo ng'agaggyanga ku ga bakabona, Abaleevi.
Ekitabo ekyo anaabeeranga nakyo bulijjo, era anaakisomanga ennaku zonna ez'obulamu bwe, alyokenga ayige okutyanga
Katonda we, ng'agobereranga n'obwegendereza ebigambo byonna ebiri mu mateeka gano, ne mu biragiro,

nga teyeekulumbaza kusukkirira ku bannansi banne, era nga takyama kuva ku mateeka gano okulaga ku mukono ogwa ddyo oba ku gwa kkono. Bw'anaakolanga bw'atyo, ye, n'ezzadde lye banaafuganga mu bwakabaka bwe, mu Isirayiri, okumala ennaku nnyingi.

items.text: Bakabona, Abaleevi n'ekika kyonna ekya Leevi, tebaafunenga mugabo oba bya busika mu Isirayiri. Banaaweebwanga ku biweebwayo ebyokebwa ebinaaleetebwanga eri
Katonda; ogwo gwe gunaabanga omugabo ogw'obusika bwabwe.
Tebaabeerenga na mugabo gwa busika nga bannaabwe abalala bonna mu Isirayiri, kubanga
Katonda yabasuubiza nga y'anaabanga obusika bwabwe.
Bino bakabona bye banaagabananga ku biweebwayo eby'ente za sseddume n'endiga abantu bye banaabanga baleese: bakabona banaafunangako omukono n'emba zombi, n'eby'omu lubuto.
Era onoobawanga ebibala byo ebibereberye eby'emmere ey'empeke, n'ebya wayini wo, n'amafuta go, n'ebyoya ebisooka eby'endiga zo.
Katonda wo yeeroboza Leevi n'ezzadde lye mu bika byo byonna okuweerezanga mu linnya lya
Omuleevi bw'anaavanga mu kimu ku bibuga byo ebiri mu Isirayiri gy'abadde atuula, n'ajja nga bw'anaabanga yeeteeserezza, n'ajja mu kifo
Katonda we okufaanana nga Abaleevi banne abalala aba buli kiseera abanaabanga baweereza mu linnya lya
Anaagabananga kyenkanyi ne banne abaabulijjo, ne bw'anaabanga ng'alina ensimbi ezize ku bubwe z'anaabanga aggye mu by'omu maka ge by'atunze.
Katonda wo gy'akuwa, weekuume obutayiga kukopperera mpisa embi ez'abantu ab'omu mawanga g'olisanga mu nsi omwo.

Tewabeerangawo omuntu n'omu alirabika ng'ayisa mutabani we, oba muwala we mu muliro, ng'ekiweebwayo, oba ng'akola ng'omulaguzi, oba omulogo, oba omusawo w'ekinnansi, oba avvuunula eby'omu biseera ebijja,
oba asuula abantu eddalu, oba emmandwa, oba omusamize, oba omulubaale, oba ayogera n'emizimu, oba eyeebuuza ku baafa.
Omuntu yenna anaakolanga ebintu ng'ebyo, anaabanga kivume era ekyomuzizo eri
. Era olwokubanga ab'omu mawanga ago bakola ebyomuzizo ebyo,
Katonda wo kyanaava abagoba mu nsi omwo ng'ogiyingira.
Kikugwanira obenga muwulize nnyo, atuukiridde mu maaso ga
Newaakubadde ng'abantu ab'omu mawanga ago b'ogenda okulyako ensi yaabwe, bagondera nnyo abalaguzi n'abasamize, naye ebyo
Katonda wo agenda kukuyimusiza Nnabbi ali nga nze, ng'amuggya mu bantu bo. Nnabbi oyo mumuwulirizanga era mumugonderanga.
Katonda wo ku lunaku olw'okukuŋŋaana ku lusozi Kolebu ng'ogamba nti, "Sisaanidde kuddayo nate kuwulira ddoboozi lya
Katonda wange wadde okuddayo okulaba omuliro guno omungi, nneme okufa."
Katonda kwe kunnyanukula nti, "Kye bagambye kirungi era kituufu.
Nzija kubayimusiza Nnabbi ali nga ggwe okuva wakati mu bo; Nze nnaasanga ebigambo byange mu kammwe ke, ye n'abategeezanga bye nnaamulagiranga.
Omuntu yenna ataagonderenga bigambo Nnabbi by'anaayogeranga mu linnya lyange, Nze kennyini, Nze nnaamwekolerangako.
Naye nnabbi anaayogeranga mu linnya lya bakatonda abalala, oba aneetulinkirizanga nti ayogera mu linnya lyange, songa si Nze mmulagidde okubyogera, nnabbi oyo wa kufa."
Oyinza okwebuuza nti, "Tunaamanyanga tutya ng'ebigambo ebyo
Ebigambo nnabbi by'anaayogeranga mu linnya lya
bwe bitaatuukirirenga oba bwe bitaabenga bya mazima, ng'ebigambo ebyo
Katonda si y'abyogedde. Nnabbi oyo by'anaabanga ayogedde anaabanga abiyiiyizza buyiiya. Ebyo tebibatiisanga.

items.text: Katonda wo bw'alimala okuzikiriza amawanga kaakano agali mu nsi gy'akuwa, n'ogyefunira, ne weetwalira ebibuga byabwe, n'amaka gaabwe n'obeera omwo,
Okolanga enguudo eziraga mu bibuga ebyo; ensi
Katonda wo gy'akuwa okubeera obusika bwo obw'enkalakkalira, ogyawulangamu ebitundu bisatu, kale buli anattanga omuntu anaddukiranga mu kimu ku bibuga eby'omu bitundu ebyo.
Etteeka lino likwata ku muntu anattanga munne nga tagenderedde kubanga anaabanga tamulinaako kiruyi kyonna, oyo eyasse anaddukiranga mu kimu ku bibuga ebyo awonye obulamu bwe.

Ekyokulabirako kiikino: Singa omuntu agenda ne munne okutema omuti mu kibira n'embazzi, naye ng'abadde agiwuuba ateme omuti, embazzi n'ewanguka mu kiti kyayo, n'etema munne n'afa, eyasse anaayinzanga okuddukira mu kimu ku bibuga ebyo, n'atattibwa.

Ebibuga ebyo tebisaanira kuba wala nnyo, kubanga oli ayagala okuwalanira omufu eggwanga bw'anaafubanga okugoba eyasse embiro okutuusa ng'amukutte, aleme kusobola kumukwata, naye n'amutta, songa eyasse oli yali tagenderedde kutta munne, kubanga ku bombi tekwaliko mulabe wa munne.
Katonda wo bw'anaakugaziyirizanga amatwale go, nga bwe yalayirira bajjajjaabo, n'akuwa ettaka lyonna lye yasuubiza bajjajjaabo,
kasita onookwatanga amateeka gonna ge nkulagira leero, kwe kwagalanga
Katonda wo, n'okutambuliranga mu makubo ge, kale ku bibuga bino ebisatu onooyongerangako ebirala bisatu.
Ekyo onookikolanga okuziyiza omusaayi gw'omuntu ataliiko musango okuyiikira obwereere mu nsi yo
Katonda wo gy'akuwa okubeera obusika bwo obw'enkalakkalira, omusaayi oguyiise gulemenga kubeera ku ggwe.
Naye omuntu bw'anaabanga n'ekiruyi ku munne, n'amwekwekerera n'amutta, n'alyoka addukira mu kimu ku bibuga ebyo,
abakulembeze abakulu ab'omu kibuga ky'omutemu, banaamutumyangayo ne bamuggyayo, ne bamukwasa anaabanga agenda okuwoolera eggwanga ery'omusaayi gw'omufu, omutemu n'alyoka attibwa.
Tomusaasiranga. Kikugwanira okumalirawo ddala mu Isirayiri okuyiwa omusaayi ogutaliiko musango, olyoke obeerenga bulungi n'emirembe.
Tosimbulanga bituuti ebiri mu mpenda eziraga ensalo ya buli muntu ne muliraanwa we, ebyasimbibwawo ab'omu mirembe egyasooka, ebiraga ettaka ly'onoogabana mu nsi

Omujulizi omu taamalenga, okusinzisa omuntu omusango gw'anaabanga azzizza, oba olw'ekikolwa ekibi ky'anaabanga akoze nga kyekuusa ku musango gw'anaabanga azzizza. Wanaamalanga kubeerawo obujulizi bw'abantu babiri oba basatu, olwo nno ekivunaanwa omuntu oyo ne kiryoka kinywezebwa.
Omujulizi ow'obulimba bw'aneesowolangayo n'avunaana omuntu nti musobya,
abantu bombi abawozaŋŋanya banajjanga mu maaso ga
Katonda awali bakabona n'abalamuzi abanaabanga ku mulimu mu kiseera ekyo.
Abalamuzi kinaabagwaniranga okubuulirizanga ennyo n'obwegendereza. Omujulizi oyo bw'anaakakasibwanga nga mulimba, ng'obujulizi bw'awadde ku munne bugingirire,
munaamukolangako nga naye bw'abadde ayagala munne akolweko. Bw'atyo n'omalirawo ddala ebikolwa ebibi ebiri wakati mu mmwe.
Abalala bwe banaakiwuliranga banaatyanga, ng'olwo mu mmwe temukyali baddayo kuzzanga musango gufaanana ng'ogwo.
Tobasaasiranga; obulamu busasulwenga na bulamu, eriiso olw'eriiso, erinnyo olw'erinnyo, omukono olw'omukono n'ekigere olw'ekigere.

items.text: Bw'onoobanga ogenze okutabaala abalabe bo, n'olaba embalaasi n'amagaali n'eggye eddene okukira eriryo, tobatyanga; kubanga
Katonda wo, eyakuggya mu nsi y'e Misiri, anaabanga naawe.
Bwe munaabanga muli kumpi okutandika okulwana, kabona anajjanga n'ayogera eri eggye ly'abaserikale,
n'abagamba nti, "Wulira, Ayi Isirayiri! Olwa leero mugenda okutandika okulwana n'abalabe bammwe. Temuggwaamu mutima, so temutiitiira wadde okubatya.
Katonda wammwe y'anaagendanga nammwe okubalwanirira ng'alwanyisanga abalabe bammwe, n'okubawanga mmwe obuwanguzi."

Abaami banaayogeranga eri eggye nga bagamba nti, "Waliwo mu mmwe alina ennyumba empya gye yeezimbira naye nga tennatukuzibwa? Kimusanidde addeyo mu nnyumba ye, si kulwa ng'afiira mu lutalo, omulala n'agitukuza.
Waliwo mu mmwe eyalima ennimiro y'emizabbibu naye nga tannatandika kulya ku bibala byamu? Kimusaanidde addeyo mu maka ge, si kulwa ng'afiira mu lutalo, omuntu omulala n'alya ebibala byamu.
Waliwo mu mmwe eyali ayogereza omukazi, naye nga tannamuwasa? Kimugwanidde addeyo mu maka ge, si kulwa ng'afiira mu lutalo, omuntu omulala n'awasa omukazi oyo."

Abaami banaayongeranga okwogera eri eggye nga bagamba nti, "Waliwo mu mmwe omutiitiizi, oba aweddemu amaanyi mu mutima? Kimusaanidde addeyo mu maka ge, si kulwa ng'aleetera banne omutima omutiitiizi."
Abaami bwe banaamalanga okwogera eri eggye, banaalondanga abakulu mu balwanyi abanaakulemberanga eggye eryo.
Bw'onoosembereranga ekibuga ng'ogenda okukirwanyisa, osookanga kulangirira mirembe eri abantu baamu.
Bwe banakkirizanga emirembe, ne bakuggulirawo emiryango gy'ekibuga kyabwe, kale abantu baamu bonna banaafuukanga baweereza bo, okukukoleranga byonna nga bw'onooyagalanga.
Naye ekibuga ekyo bwe kinaagaananga okukkiriza emirembe, ne kisalawo okukulwanyisa, onookyebungululanga n'okizingiza.
Katonda wo bw'anaakigabulanga mu mukono gwo, onottanga n'ekitala buli musajja yenna.

Kyokka abakazi n'abaana abato, n'ebisibo by'ensolo, n'ebintu byonna ebinaabanga mu kibuga omwo, onoobyetwaliranga ng'omunyago gwo. Era onookozesanga nga bw'onooyagalanga omunyago gwonna ogunaavanga mu balabe bo
Bw'otyo bw'onookolanga ebibuga byonna ebinaakubeeranga ewala ennyo, ebitaabenga bibuga bya mawanga gano.
Katonda wo by'akuwa okuba obusika bwo obw'enkalakkalira, tewaabeerengawo kintu n'ekimu ky'onoolekangamu nga kissa omukka, byonna onoobizikiririzanga ddala.
Abakiiti, n'Abamoli, n'Abakanani, n'Abaperezi, n'Abakiivi, n'Abayebusi, onoobamalirangawo ddala, nga
balemenga kubayigiriza bikolobero bye bakola nga basinza bakatonda baabwe, bwe mutyo nammwe ne mwonoonanga eri

Bw'onoozingizanga ekibuga, ng'olwana nakyo, okumala ebbanga eddene olyoke okiwangule, toddiranga mbazzi n'ozikiriza emiti gyakyo gyonna, kubanga ojjanga kwetaaga okulyanga ku bibala byagyo. Togitemanga. Emiti egy'omu nnimiro nagyo bantu olyoke ogizingize?
Naye emiti gy'omanyi nga si gya bibala, egyo onoogitemanga olyoke ogikozesenga okuzimba ekisenge kw'onoosinziiranga okulwananga n'ekibuga ky'onoobanga ozingizza, okutuusa lwe kinaagwanga.

items.text: Katonda gy'akuwa okugirya, omuntu n'asangibwa mu nsiko ng'attiddwa, kyokka ng'eyamusse tamanyiddwa,
bakadde bo, abakulembeze, n'abalamuzi bo banaafulumanga ne bagenda bapima obuwanvu bw'ebbanga okuva ku mulambo okutuuka ku bibuga ebinaabanga bigwebulunguludde.
Kale nno abakadde abakulembeze b'ekibuga ekinaabanga kisinga okuliraana n'omulambo ogwo, banaaddiranga ente enduusi etakozesebwangako mulimu gwonna, etassibwangamu kikoligo,
ne bagiserengesa mu kiwonvu ekirimu akagga akakulukuta; ekitalimwangamu wadde okusimbwamu emmere. Mu kiwonvu omwo mwe banaanyoleranga ensingo y'ente eyo ne bagimenya.
Kale nno batabani ba Leevi, bakabona, banaavangayo ne basembera, kubanga
Katonda wo yabalonda okumuweerezanga, n'okusabiranga emikisa mu linnya lya
Awo abakadde abakulembeze bonna ab'omu kibuga ekinaasinganga okuliraana omulambo ogwo, banaanaabiranga engalo zaabwe ku nte eri enduusi eyamenyebbwa ensingo mu kiwonvu
ne boogera nti, "Emikono gyaffe si gye gyayiwa omusaayi guno, ne bwe gwali guyiyibwa amaaso gaffe tegaagulaba, tetwaliwo nga guyiyibwa.
Osonyiwe abantu bo, Isirayiri, be wanunula Ayi
Katonda, oleme kuleka wakati mu bantu bo, Isirayiri, omusango ogw'okuyiwa omusaayi, gwe batazzanga." Bwe batyo banaasonyiyibwanga omusango gw'omusaayi ogwo.
Bw'otyo bw'onoggyangawo omusango wakati wammwe ogw'okuyiwa omusaayi ogutaliiko nsonga, kubanga onoobanga okoze ekituufu mu maaso ga
n'abagabula mu mikono gyo n'onyagayo abantu,
mu abo abanyagiddwa bw'onoolabangamu omukazi alabika obulungi n'omwagala, n'oyagala okumuwasa,
omutwalanga mu maka go, n'omulagira okumwa omutwe gwe, n'okusalako enjala ze,
n'engoye ze mwe yawambirwa azeeyambulangamu. Bw'anaamalanga mu nju yo omwezi mulamba ng'akungubagira kitaawe ne nnyina, onoogendanga gy'ali n'obeera bba, naye anaabeeranga mukazi wo.
Kyokka bw'anaabanga takusanyusizza, omuwanga eddembe n'agenda so tomutundanga nsimbi. Tomuyisanga nga muddu, kubanga ggwe wamumalamu ekitiibwa kye.
Omusajja bw'anaabanga n'abakazi babiri, omu nga muganzi naye omulala nga mukyawe, bombi ne bamuzaalira abaana aboobulenzi, naye ng'omwana omubereberye ye w'omukyawe;
bw'anaabanga agabira batabani be abo ebintu bye mu ddaame lye, takkirizibwenga kuyisa mwana wa muganzi ng'omubereberye, singa omwana w'omukyawe ye mubereberye.

Anaasaaniranga okukkiriza nti omwana w'omukyawe ye mubereberye, era anaamuwanga emiteeko ebiri egy'ebintu bye byonna by'alina, kubanga oyo ge maanyi ga kitaawe amabereberye. Ye nannyini ddembe ery'obwebange ery'omwana omubereberye.
Omuntu bw'anaabanga ne mutabani we omukakanyavu omujeemu atagondera biragiro bya kitaawe wadde ebya nnyina, atabafaako bwe bamubonerezaamu olw'obutawulira,
kitaawe ne nnyina banaamukwatanga ne bamuleeta eri abakulu abakulembeze ab'omu kibuga kye waabwe nga bali wabweru w'omulyango gw'ekibuga ekyo.
Banaategeezanga abakulu abakulembeze b'omu kibuga kye waabwe nti, "Mutabani waffe ono mukakanyavu era mujeemu. Tatuwulira. Wa mulugube nnyo era mutamiivu."
Kale nno abasajja b'omu kibuga ekyo banaamukubanga amayinja ne bamutta. Bw'otyo bw'onoomalangawo ekibi wakati wo. Isirayiri yenna anaakiwuliranga, n'atya.
Omuntu bw'anaasingibwanga ogw'okufa n'attibwa, n'awanikibwa ku muti,
omulambo gwe teguulekebwenga ku muti ne gusulako ekiro kyonna; onoomuziikanga ku lunaku olwo lwennyini, kubanga omuntu awanikibwa ku muti, Katonda aba amukolimidde. Togwagwawazanga nsi
Katonda wo gy'akuwa okugirya okubeera obusika bwo obw'enkalakkalira.

items.text: Bw'olabanga ente ya munno, oba endiga ye, ng'ebula okuva ewaabayo, togirekanga bulesi ne weesuulirayo ogwa nnaggamba naye ogikwatanga n'ogizzaayo ewa nnyiniyo.
Nannyini yo bw'abanga tasula kumpi naawe, obanga nannyini yo tomumanyi, ogireetanga mu maka go n'obeeranga nayo okutuusa nannyini yo lw'alijja ng'aginoonya; olwo nno n'olyoka ogimuddiza.

Okolanga bw'otyo ng'osanze endogoyi ya munno, obanga olonze ekyambalo kya munno, oba ekintu kyonna ekirala munno ky'anaabanga abuliddwa kyokka ggwe n'okironda. Tolemanga kuyamba munno ng'ali mu buzibu, ate nga wandisobodde okumuyamba. Obusobozi bw'onoobanga nabwo okuyamba munno tobumukwekanga.
Bw'onoolabanga endogoyi ya munno, oba ente ye, ng'egudde ku kkubo, togiyitangako buyisi, wabula omuyambanga okugiyimusa.
Omusajja Okwefaanaanyiriza Omukazi, oba Omukazi Okwefaanaanyiriza Omusajja
Omukazi taayambalenga ngoye za kisajja, so n'omusajja taayambalenga ngoye za kikazi; kubanga abakola ebyo

Temutwalanga Nnyonyi Nzadde. Bwe munaalabanga ekisu ky'ennyonyi ku muti, oba ku mabbali g'ekkubo, nga kirimu amagi oba obwana obuto, nga ne nnyina waabwo abumaamidde, oba atudde ku magi, bwe munaatwalanga obwana obuto, nnyina waabwo temumutwalirangako.
Obwana obuto munaayinzanga okubutwala, kyokka nnyina waabwo mumulekanga n'agenda, mulyoke mufunenga emirembe mu mutima awamu n'obuwangaazi.
Bwe muneezimbiranga enju empya ey'akasolya akatereevu

akatali keesulifu, mukolangako akasenge waggulu okwebungulula akasolya ako, kalyoke kaziyizenga omuntu okuva eyo waggulu n'agwa wansi, n'aleeteranga ennyumba eyo omusango olw'omusaayi ogunaabanga guyiise.
Wakati w'ennyiriri z'emizabbibu temusimbangamu mmere ya ngeri ndala, bwe munaakikolanga, ebibala by'emizabbibu n'eby'emmere gye munaabanga musimbyemu, byombi munaabifiirwanga.
Ente n'endogoyi temuzigattanga wamu ne muzisibanga ku kikoligo kye kimu eky'ekyuma kye munaabanga mulimisa.
Temwambalanga ngoye ezinaabanga zirukiddwa n'ewuzi z'ebyoya by'endiga nga zigattiddwa wamu n'ewuzi eza linena.
Mutunganga emijunga ku buli nsonda ennya ez'eminagiro gyammwe gye munaayambalanga.
Omusajja bw'aneewasizanga omukazi, kyokka oluvannyuma lw'okusula naye, n'amukyawa,
n'amuwaayiriza ng'amukonjera ng'agamba nti, "Nawasa omukazi ono, naye bwe nasula naye saamusanga nga mbeerera,"
Kitaawe w'omuwala oyo ne nnyina banaaleeteranga abakulembeze abakulu ab'ekibuga ekyo, nga bali ku wankaaki waakyo, obujulizi obunaalaganga ng'omuwala waabwe yali mbeerera.
Kitaawe w'omuwala anaategeezanga abakulembeze abakulu nti, "Nagabira omusajja ono omwana wange omuwala amuwase, naye omusajja amukyaye.

Kaakano wuuno amuwaayiriza ng'amukonjera ng'amwogerako nti, Muwala wo namusanga nga si mbeerera." Naye obujulizi buubuno obulaga ng'omwana wange ono omuwala yali mbeerera. Abazadde b'omuwala banaayanjululizanga essuuka y'obuliri mu maaso g'abakulembeze abakulu ab'ekibuga ekyo.
Abakulembeze abakulu b'ekibuga ekyo banaatwalanga bba w'omuwala, banaasookanga okumukubamu.
Ate ne bamusalira omutango gwa sekeri za ffeeza kikumi

; banaaziwanga kitaawe w'omuwala; kubanga omusajja oyo anaabanga aleese erinnya ebbi ku muwala wa Isirayiri embeerera. Omuwala oyo anaabeeranga mu maka g'omusajja oyo ebbanga lyonna, era omusajja takkirizibwenga kugoba mukazi we oyo ebiro byonna omusajja oyo by'alimala nga mulamu.
Naye singa omusajja nga by'anaabanga ayogedde bya mazima, nga n'obujulizi obukakasa ng'omuwala yali mbeerera bunaabanga bubuze,

kale nno omuwala oyo anaaleetebwanga ku muzigo gw'ennyumba ya kitaawe, era abasajja ab'omu kibuga ky'omuwala oyo banaamukubiranga awo amayinja n'afa. Kubanga anaabanga akoze ekikolwa kya bugwenyufu nnyo eky'okumanya abasajja ng'akyali mu luggya lwa kitaawe. Ekibi musaananga mukimalemu mu Isirayiri.
Omusajja bw'anaakwatibwanga nga yeebase n'omukyala w'omusajja omulala, kale, omusajja akwatiddwa n'omukyala gw'anaabanga yeebase naye, bombi baakuttibwanga. Ekibi musaana mukimalengamu mu Isirayiri.
Bwe wanaabangawo omuwala embeerera ayogerezebwa afumbirwe, omusajja n'amusanga mu kibuga ne yeebaka naye,

munaabaleetanga bombi ku wankaaki w'ekibuga ekyo ne mubakuba amayinja ne bafa; omuwala, bwe kibanga nga yali munda mu kibuga naye n'atakuba nduulu kufuna buyambi; omusajja, kubanga yayonoona omuwala ajja okufumbirwa omusajja we. Bwe mutyo bwe munaamalangamu ekibi mu mmwe.
Naye omusajja bw'anaasanganga omuwala ayogerezebwa ku ttale n'amukwata ne yeebaka naye olw'empaka, kale nno omusajja anaabanga yeebase n'omuwala oyo y'anattibwanga.
Omuwala oyo temumukolangako kintu kyonna, kubanga anaabanga talina kibi kyonna ky'akoze ekinaamusaanyizanga okufa. Ensonga ezo zifaanana ng'ez'omuntu anaabanga alumbaganye muliraanwa we n'amutemula.
Olwokubanga omuwala ono anaabanga ayogerezebwa okufumbirwa yasangibwa omusajja ku ttale etali bantu, anaayinzanga okuba nga yeekubira enduulu naye ne watabaawo amudduukirira okumuyamba.
Omusajja bw'anasisinkananga omuwala embeerera naye nga taliiko amwogereza, n'amukwata ne yeebaka naye, ne bakwatibwa nga bali mu kikolwa ekyo,
omusajja anaabanga yeebase n'omuwala oyo anaasasulanga kitaawe w'omuwala sekeri eza ffeeza amakumi ataano.
Omusajja anaawasanga omuwala oyo okuba mukazi we, kubanga anaabanga amaze okumusobyako. Era taamugobenga okumala ebbanga lyonna omusajja oyo nga mulamu.
Omusajja taawasenga mukyala wa kitaawe aleme kuweebuulanga kitiibwa kya buliri bwa kitaawe.

items.text: "Omuntu yenna ng'ebitundu by'omubiri gwe eby'ekyama byabetentebwa oba nga byasalibwako, taayingirenga mu kuŋŋaaniro lya
"Abantu bonna abanaazaalibwanga mu bufumbo obutaabenga butukuvu tebaayingirenga mu kuŋŋaaniro lya
Katonda. Bazzukulu baabwe okutuusa ku mulembe ogw'ekkumi, nabo tebayingiranga mu kuŋŋaaniro lya
"Abamoni n'Abamowaabu ne bazzukulu baabwe okutuusa ku mulembe ogw'ekkumi tebayingiranga mu kuŋŋaaniro lya
Kubanga bwe mwali muva mu nsi y'e Misiri, tebajja kubaaniriza n'okubaleetera ku mmere ne ku mazzi; ate ne bapangisa Balamu mutabani wa Byoli nga bamuggya e Pesoli eky'omu Mesopotamiya, okubakolimira.
Katonda wo n'alemesa Balamu; ekikolimo n'akikufuuliramu omukisa, kubanga
Tokolanga nabo endagaano ey'omukwano n'okubayamba mu mbeera yaabwe ebbanga lyonna ly'olimala ng'oli mulamu.
"Omwedomu tomukyawanga kubanga omulinako oluganda. Tokyawanga Mumisiri n'omu kubanga wali mugenyi mu nsi yaabwe.
Abaana baabwe ab'omulembe ogwokusatu banaakkirizibwanga okuyingira mu kuŋŋaaniro lya
"Bw'onoogendanga okutabaala abalabe bo weewalenga obutali bulongoofu mu lusiisira lwammwe.
Bwe wanaabangawo omusajja mu mmwe eyeeroteredde ekiro, bw'atyo n'aba atali mulongoofu, anaafulumanga mu lusiisira n'abeera ebweru.
Naye obudde bwe bunaawungeeranga anaanaabanga n'amazzi; enjuba bw'eneemalanga okugwa anaayinzanga okukomawo mu lusiisira.
Onoogendangayo n'eby'okukozesa. Onootwalanga ekifumu, bw'onoomalanga okweteewuluza onoosimanga ekinnya n'oziikamu ebyo ebivudde mu nda yo.
Katonda wo anaatambulanga naawe, mu lusiisira lwo ng'akulabirira n'okukuyamba okuwangula abalabe bammwe. Noolwekyo olusiisira lwo kirusaanira lubeerenga lutukuvu,
alemenga kusangamu kintu kyonna ekitali kirongoofu mu ggwe ne kimuleeteranga okukuvaako.
"Omuddu omugule bw'anaabombanga n'ava ku mukama we mu nsi endala, n'ajja ne yeekweka gy'oli, tomuzzangayo wa mukama we.
Omulekanga n'abeera naawe wakati mu mmwe, mu kimu ku bibuga byo ky'aneerobozanga. Tomujooganga.
"Mu bawala ba Isirayiri temukkirizibwenga kubeerangamu bamalaaya ab'omu masabo, n'abasajja abalya ebisiyaga nabo tebakkirizibwenga mu Isirayiri.
Toleetanga nsimbi, bamalaaya ze banaabanga bafunye mu bwamalaaya, mu nnyumba ya
Katonda wo okusasulira obweyamo, wadde ensimbi z'abasajja abalya ebisiyaga; kubanga
Katonda wo akyayira ddala ebikolwa ebyo byombi.
"Omuyisirayiri bw'anaawolanga Muyisirayiri munne ensimbi, oba emmere, oba ebintu ebirala byonna, bw'anaabanga asasulwa tasabirangako magoba gaabyo.
Katonda wo alyoke akuwenga omukisa ku buli ky'onookwatangako engalo ng'otuuse mu nsi gy'oli okumpi okuyingira n'okugyefunira.
Katonda wo agenda kukikulagira olyoke weewonye omusango olw'ekibi ekyo.
Ebyo byonna akamwa ko bye kanaayogeranga kikugwanira okubikolanga, mu ngeri y'emu nga bw'onoobanga weeyamye obweyamo eri
"Bw'onooyingiranga mu nnimiro ya munno ey'emizabbibu, onooyinzanga okwenogeranga ku birimba by'emizabbibu n'olya nga bw'oneetaaganga n'okkuta, naye tossangako mu kibbo okwetwalirako eka.
Bw'onooyingiranga mu nnimiro ya munno ey'emmere ey'empeke, onooyinzanga okwekungulirangako n'engalo zo, naye toddiranga kambe n'osala emmere y'empeke eyo eneebanga tennaba kusalibwa."

items.text: Omusajja bw'anaawasanga omukazi, naye oluvannyuma n'amukyawa, kubanga amuvumbuddeko ebitamusanyusa, bw'atyo n'amuwandiikira ebbaluwa ey'okumugoba, n'agimukwasa, n'amugoba mu nnyumba ye,
omukazi oyo anaayinzanga okwefunira omusajja omulala n'amufumbirwa.
Omusajja ono owookubiri naye bw'anaamukyawanga n'amuwandiikira ebbaluwa ey'okumugoba, n'agimukwasa, n'amugoba mu nnyumba ye, oba omusajja oyo owookubiri bw'anaafanga;
bba eyasooka, eyali amugobye takkirizibwenga kuddamu kumuwasa kuba mukazi we, kubanga omukazi oyo anaabanga amaze okwebaka n'omusajja omulala. Ekyo kinaabanga kya kivve mu maaso ga
Katonda wo gy'akuwa okubeera obutaka bwo obw'enkalakkalira.

Omusajja bw'anaabanga yaakawasa taalondebwenga kugenda kutabaala oba okuweebwa omulimu omulala omunene ng'ogwo. Anaasigalanga mu maka ge okumala ebbanga lya mwaka mulamba ng'asanyusa mukazi we gw'anaabanga awasizza.
Omuntu bw'awolanga munne n'amusaba omusingo, oba akakalu, tamuggyangako lubengo oba enso ng'omusingo oba akakalu, kubanga mu musingo ng'ogwo, aba atwaliddemu obulamu bwa munne.
Omuntu bw'anaakwatibwanga ng'awamba, obanga atunda Omuyisirayiri munne mu buddu, kale omuwambi anattibwanga. Bw'otyo bw'onoomalangamu ekibi wakati mu mmwe.
Bwe wanaagwangawo obulwadde obw'olususu ng'obw'ebigenge, weegenderezanga nnyo, n'ogonderanga ebyo Abaleevi, bakabona, bye banaabalagiranga okukola, nga bwe mbalagidde.
Katonda wo kye yakola Miryamu nga muli mu lugendo lwammwe nga muva mu Misiri.
Bw'owolanga munno ekintu eky'engeri yonna, toyingiranga mu nnyumba ya munno oyo okunonamu omusingo.
Ggwe awoze onaabeeranga wabweru n'olindirira oyo gw'onoobanga owoze, okukuleetera omusingo ogwo.
Gw'owoze bw'anaabanga omwavu, ekyambalo ky'anaabanga akuwadde ng'omusingo, tosulanga nakyo.
Enjuba bw'eneebanga yaakagwa, onookiddizanga munno oyo alyoke akyebikke ekiro nga yeebase. Bw'atyo anaakwebazanga era kinaabanga kikolwa kya butuukirivu mu maaso ga

Toyiikirizanga mwavu n'omupakasi ali mu kwetaaga, n'olwawo okumusasula empeera ye; ne bw'anaabanga Omuyisirayiri munno oba ow'okubannamawanga abanaabeeranga mu nsi yo nga basula mu kimu ku bibuga byo.
Onoomusasulanga empeera ye eya buli lunaku ng'enjuba tennaba kugwa, kubanga mwavu n'omutima gwe gubeera ku mpeera eyo. Kubanga bw'onoomulagajjaliranga, anaayinzanga okukaabirira
Katonda n'akuloopayo, bw'otyo onoogwanga mu musango ogw'ekibi.
Bakitaabwe b'abaana tebattibwenga nga babalanganga abaana baabwe, n'abaana tebattibwenga nga babalanganga bakitaabwe; buli omu anattibwanga ng'alangibwanga ekibi kye ye yennyini.
Bannamawanga b'onoobeeranga nabo, n'abaana bamulekwa, obasaliranga emisango gyabwe n'obwenkanya, era totwalanga kyambalo kya nnamwandu ng'omusingo.
Ojjukiranga nga bwe wali omuddu mu Misiri, naye
Katonda wo n'akununulayo. Kyenva nkulagira okukolanga bw'otyo.
Bw'onookungulanga ebibala mu nnimiro yo ne weerabirayo ekinywa mu nnimiro, toddangayo kukikima. Onookirekeranga omunnaggwanga oba omwana omufuuzi oba nnamwandu; bw'atyo
alyoke akuwenga omukisa mu byonna by'onookolanga.

Bw'onookubanga emizeeyituuni okuva ku miti gyo, toddangayo ku matabi mulundi gwakubiri okumalirako ddala ebibala ebinaabanga bisigaddeko. Ebyo binaabanga bya bannamawanga, n'abaana bamulekwa ne bannamwandu.
Bw'onookungulanga emizabbibu okuva mu nnimiro yo, toddangamu mulundi gwakubiri. Ebibala ebinaabanga bisigaddeko onoobirekeranga bannamawanga, ne bamulekwa ne bannamwandu.
Ojjukiranga nga bwe wali omuddu mu nsi ey'e Misiri; kyenva nkulagira okukolanga bw'otyo.

items.text: Abantu babiri bwe banaabanga n'enkaayana, ensonga zaabwe ne bazitwala mu mbuga z'amateeka, abalamuzi ne babasalirawo, banaalangiriranga asinze n'oyo gwe gusinze.
Singa oyo gwe gunaasiŋŋanga anaabanga asaanira okukubwangamu obuga, omulamuzi anaamugalamizanga wansi n'akubirwa mu maaso ge omuwendo gw'obuga obuggya mu musango gw'anaabanga azzizza,
naye nga tebusukka buga amakumi ana. Bwe bunaasukkanga omuwendo ogwo munnammwe anaabanga aswazibbwa nnyo mu maaso gammwe.
temugisibanga mimwa bwe munaabanga mugikozesa okuwuula emmere ey'empeke.

Abooluganda bwe banaabanga babeera wamu, omu n'afa nga talina mwana wabulenzi, nnamwandu we tafumbirwanga musajja atali wa mu luggya lwa bba. Muganda wa bba anaatwalanga nnamwandu oyo n'amuwasa, n'atuukiriza obuvunaanyizibwa bwa muganda we omugenzi eri nnamwandu oyo.
Omwana owoobulenzi gw'anaasookanga okuzaala y'anaasikiranga erinnya lya muganda we omugenzi, bwe lityo erinnya ly'omugenzi ne litasangulwawo mu Isirayiri.

Naye omusajja bw'anaabanga tayagala kuwasa nnamwandu wa muganda we, nnamwandu oyo anaagendanga eri abakulembeze abakulu ab'omu kibuga kye, ku wankaaki, n'abagamba nti, "Muganda wa baze agaanye okuwangaaza erinnya lya muganda we mu Isirayiri. Kubanga agaanye okutuukiriza gye ndi obuvunaanyizibwa bw'alina ku muganda we."
Abakulembeze abakulu b'omu kibuga banaayitanga omusajja oyo ne boogera naye. Bw'anaakakanyalanga n'agamba nti, "Saagala kumuwasa,"

kale, nnamwandu wa muganda we anaatambulanga n'alaga awali omusajja oyo mu maaso g'abakulembeze abakulu b'omu kibuga, anaamwambulangamu engatto mu kigere kye ekimu, era anaamuwandiranga amalusu mu maaso n'ayogera nti, "Bwe kityo bwe kinaakolebwanga ku musajja atazimba lunyiriri lwa luggya lwa muganda we."
Oluggya lw'omusajja oyo lunaamanyibwanga mu Isirayiri ng'Oluggya lw'Omwambule Engatto.
Bwe wanaabangawo abasajja babiri abalwana, mukazi w'omu bw'anajjanga okutaasa bba ku mulabe we n'amukwata ebitundu bye eby'ekyama,
Tossanga mu nsawo zo mayinja gapima ga ngeri bbiri ez'enjawulo, ng'erimu lizitowa, kyokka nga linnaalyo liwewuka.
Tobeeranga na bipima bya ngeri bbiri eby'enjawulo, ng'ekimu kinene, kyokka nga kinnaakyo kitono.
Kikugwanira obeerenga n'amayinja agapima obuzito obutuufu, era n'ebipima ebirala eby'amazima era ebituufu, olyoke owangaalenga ng'oli mu nsi
Katonda wo akyayira ddala abo bonna abakola ebyo ebitali bya bwesigwa.
Teweerabiranga Abamaleki bye baakukola bwe wali mu lugendo lwo ng'ova mu Misiri.
Bwe wali okooye nnyo nga n'amaanyi gakuweddemu, baakusanga mu lugendo lwo olwo, ne balumba abo bonna abaali basembyeyo emabega wo ne babatta; Katonda nga tebamutya.

Katonda wo gy'akuwa okubeera obusika bwo obw'enkalakkalira, ng'akumazeeko n'abalabe bo bonna ku njuyi zonna, ng'owummudde, ozikiririzanga ddala Abamaleki n'obamalirawo ddala bonna wansi w'eggulu, ne watabaawo baliddayo kubajjukira nti baali babaddewo. Ekyo tokyerabiranga.

items.text: Awo olulituuka bw'omalanga okuyingira mu nsi,
Katonda wo gy'akuwa okubeera obusika bwo obw'enkalakkalira, ng'omaze okugyefunira era ng'otebenkedde bulungi,
oddiranga ebimu ku bibala ebibereberye by'oliggya mu makungula agalisooka okuva mu ttaka ery'oku nsi
Katonda wo gy'akuwa, n'obiteeka mu kibbo. Kale nno obireetanga mu kifo
Katonda wo kye yeerondera okubeerangamu Erinnya lye.
Ogambanga kabona alibeera mu kisanja mu kiseera ekyo nti, "Njatula leero eri
Katonda wo nti ntuuse mu nsi
Kabona aliggya ekibbo mu mikono gyo n'akitereeza mu maaso g'ekyoto kya
Kale nno oliyatula mu maaso ga
yali mutambuze Omusuuli, n'aserengeta mu Misiri n'abantu be yali nabo abatono, ne babeera eyo, ne bafuukamu eggwanga ekkulu ery'amaanyi era nga lirimu abantu bangi nnyo.
Naye Abamisiri ne batuyisa bubi, ne batubonyaabonya, nga batukozesa emirimu emikakanyavu.
, Katonda wa bajjajjaffe; Katonda n'awulira eddoboozi lyaffe, n'alaba okubonaabona kwaffe, n'okutegana kwaffe, n'okunyigirizibwa kwaffe kwonna.
n'atuggya mu Misiri n'omukono gwe ogw'amaanyi gwe yagolola, n'obuyinza bwe obw'entiisa, n'obubonero, n'ebyamagero eby'ekitalo.
Yatuleeta mu kifo kino n'atuwa ensi eno, ensi omukulukutira amata n'omubisi gw'enjuki.
Bwe ntyo ndeese gy'oli ebibala ebibereberye ebiva mu ttaka ery'omu nsi gy'ompadde, Ayi
Katonda wo n'ovuunama mu maaso ge.
Kale nno, ggwe awamu n'Abaleevi, ne bannamawanga abanaabeeranga mu mmwe, onoojaguzanga ng'osanyukira ebirungi byonna,
Katonda wo by'anaabanga akuwadde ggwe n'amaka go gonna.

Mu mwaka ogwokusatu bw'onoomalanga okuggyako ku makungula go ekitundu eky'ekkumi n'okissa wabbali, kubanga ogwo gwe mwaka ogw'ekitundu eky'ekkumi, onoddiranga ekitundu ekyo n'okiwa Abaleevi, ne bannamawanga, ne bamulekwa, ne bannamwandu, ne baliiranga mu bibuga byo ne bakkuta.

Katonda wo nti, "Ekitundu ekimu eky'ekkumi ekyatukuzibwa nkiggyayo mu maka gange ne nkigabira Abaleevi, ne bannamawanga, ne bamulekwa, ne bannamwandu, nga byonna bye wandagira bwe biri. Sikyamyeko kuva ku biragiro byo newaakubadde okwerabira n'ekimu ku byo.
Ekitundu ekyo sikiriddeeko nga ndi mu biseera eby'okukungubaga, wadde okukikwatako nga siri mulongoofu, era sikitoddeeko ne mpaayo eri abafu. Ŋŋondedde
Katonda wange, ne nkola nga bwe yandagira.

Otutunuulire ng'osinziira mu kifo kyo ekitukuvu gy'obeera mu ggulu, otuyiweko omukisa gwo ffe abantu bo Abayisirayiri n'ensi gy'otuwadde nga bwe walayirira bajjajjaffe, nga y'ensi omukulukuta amata n'omubisi gw'enjuki."
Katonda wo akulagira leero okugonderanga amateeka ago gonna n'ebiragiro ebyo; noolwekyo obigonderanga byonna n'omutima gwo gwonna n'emmeeme yo yonna.
Ku lunaku lwa leero oyatudde nga
bw'ali Katonda wo, era nga naawe bw'onootambuliranga mu makubo ge, era ng'onookuumanga ebiragiro bye n'amateeka ge gonna, era ng'onoomugonderanga.
alangiridde nga bw'oli owuwe, eggwanga lye ku bubwe ery'omuwendo omungi nga bwe yasuubiza, era nga ojjanga kukwatanga ebiragiro bye byonna.
Alangiridde nga bw'anaakujjuzanga ettendo n'okwatiikirira n'ekitiibwa okusukkirira amawanga gonna ge yatonda, era ng'olibeera eggwanga ettukuvu eri

items.text: Awo Musa ng'ali n'abakulu abakulembeze ba Isirayiri n'alagira abantu nti, "Ebiragiro byonna bye mbategeeza leero mubikuumenga.
Bwe mumalanga okusomoka omugga Yoludaani n'oyingira mu nsi
Katonda wo gy'akuwa, oddiranga amayinja amanene n'ogategeka n'ogakubako omuyiko ogw'ennoni ng'etabuddwamu omusenyu.
Ogawandiikangako ebigambo bino byonna eby'amateeka, ng'omaze okusomoka, ng'oyingidde mu nsi
Katonda wo gy'akuwa, y'ensi omukulukutira amata n'omubisi gw'enjuki, nga
Bw'otyo, bw'olimala okusomoka omugga Yoludaani, otegekanga amayinja ago ku Lusozi Ebali nga bwe mbalagira kaakano, era ogakubangako omuyiko ogw'ennoni ng'etabuddwamu omusenyu.
Katonda wo olimuzimbira eyo ekyoto n'amayinja amalamba agatali matemeko na kyuma.
Katonda wo ekyoto n'amayinja amalamba n'oweerako ebiweebwayo ebyokebwa eri
Oliwaayo ebiweebwayo olw'emirembe, n'obiriira eyo ng'osanyukira mu maaso ga
Era ku mayinja ago g'oliba otegese oliwandiikako n'obwegendereza ebigambo byonna eby'amateeka gano."
Awo Musa ng'ali n'Abaleevi, bakabona, n'agamba Abayisirayiri bonna nti, "Sirika owulire ggwe Isirayiri! Ku lunaku lwa leero lwennyini ofuuse eggwanga lya
Katonda wo n'okwatanga amateeka ge n'ebiragiro bye, bye nkulagira leero."
Ku lunaku lwe lumu Musa yakuutira abantu bw'ati nti,
Bwe mulimala okusomoka omugga Yoludaani, ab'omu bika bino baliyimirira ku Lusozi Gerizimu ne basabira abantu omukisa: Simyoni, ne Leevi, ne Yuda, ne Isakaali, ne Yusufu, ne Benyamini.
Ate ab'omu bika bino baliyimirira ku Lusozi Ebali ne balangirira ebikolimo: Lewubeeni, ne Gaadi, ne Aseri, ne Zebbulooni, ne Ddaani, ne Nafutaali.
Awo Abaleevi balirangirira n'eddoboozi ddene eri abantu bonna Abayisirayiri nti:
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna akola ekifaananyi ekitali Katonda oba abumba ekintu ng'ekyo kyonna
ky'akyayira ddala nga kikolebwa omukozi nnakinku, omuntu oyo n'abaako ne wakiyimiriza mu kyama."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna atassaamu kitiibwa kitaawe oba nnyina."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna akyusa ekituuti ekiraga ensalo ya muliraanwa we."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna aggya omuzibe w'amaaso mu kkubo ettuufu n'amubuza."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna atalaga bwenkanya eri bannamawanga, oba bamulekwa oba bannamwandu."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna eyeebaka ne muka kitaawe, kubanga ekitanda kya kitaawe akimalamu ekitiibwa."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna eyeebaka ne mwannyina omuwala wa kitaawe, oba muwala wa nnyina."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna eyeebaka ne nnyina wa mukazi we."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna akkiriza okugulirirwa atte munne ataliiko musango."
"Akolimirwe omuntu yenna atagondera bigambo ebiri mu mateeka gano."

items.text: Katonda wo n'okwatanga amateeka ge gonna ge nkuwa leero,
Katonda wo alikugulumiza n'akuteeka waggulu w'amawanga gonna ag'oku nsi.
Emikisa gino gyonna onoogifunanga n'obeeranga nagyo, bw'onoowuliranga eddoboozi lya
Onooweebwanga omukisa bw'onoobeeranga mu kibuga ne bw'onoobeeranga mu kyalo.
Abaana ab'omu nda yo banaaweebwanga omukisa, n'ebisimbe eby'omu ttaka lyo, n'ebisibo byo ebinaazaalibwanga, Ennyana z'ente ez'amagana go, n'obwana bw'endiga ez'ebisibo byo.
Ekibbo kyo mw'onookuŋŋaanyizanga, n'olutiba lwo mw'onoogoyeranga nabyo binaabanga n'omukisa.
Onoobanga n'omukisa ng'oyingira era onoobanga n'omukisa ng'ofuluma.
anaakuwanga okuwangula abalabe bo abanaakulumbanga. Banajjiranga mu kkubo limu okukulumba, naye ne basaasaanira mu makubo musanvu mu maaso go nga bawanguddwa.
anaawanga amawanika go omukisa, ne buli ky'onookwatangako engalo zo okukikola anaakiwanga omukisa.
Katonda wo anaakuwanga omukisa ng'oli mu nsi gy'akuwa.
agenda kukufuula eggwanga lye ettukuvu nga bwe yakusuubiza n'ekirayiro, bw'onookwatanga amateeka ga
Katonda wo n'otambuliranga mu makubo ge.
Kale nno abantu ab'omu mawanga gonna ag'ensi balitegeera nga bw'oyitibwa erinnya lya
anaakugaggawazanga nnyo mu byonna: mu zadde ery'enda yo, ne mu baana ab'ebisibo byo by'onoolundanga, ne mu bibala eby'omu ttaka lyo, ng'oli mu nsi

alikuggulirawo eggwanika lye ery'obugagga bwe ery'eggulu, n'atonnyesanga enkuba mu ttaka lyo, mu biseera byayo, ne buli kintu kyonna ky'onookolanga anaakiwanga omukisa. Onoowolanga amawanga mangi, kyokka ggwe toogeewolengako n'akatono.
anaakufuulanga mutwe so si mukira. Bw'onoogonderanga ebiragiro bya
Katonda wo bye nkutegeeza leero, n'obigobereranga n'obwegendereza, onoobanga ku ntikko waggulu, so tookooberenga.
Tokyamanga kulaga ku ludda olwa ddyo oba olwa kkono, ng'oleka ebiragiro bino bye nkutegeeza leero, n'ogobereranga bakatonda abalala n'obaweerezanga.
Katonda wo, n'otokwatanga mateeka ge na biragiro bye, bye nkulagira leero, kale ebikolimo bino byonna binaakutuukangako ne bibeera naawe:
Onookolimirwanga mu kibuga n'okolimirwanga ne mu kyalo.
Ekibbo kyo mw'onookuŋŋaanyirizanga n'olutiba lwo mw'onoogoyeranga binaakolimirwanga.
Abaana b'enda yo banaakolimirwanga, n'ekibala ky'ettaka lyo, n'ennyana z'amagana go, n'obwana bw'ebisibo byo byonna binaakolimirwanga.

anaakusindikiranga ebikolimo, n'okutabukatabuka, n'okunenyezebwa mu buli kintu kyonna ky'onoogezangako okukola, okutuusa lw'olizikirizibwa n'osaanawo mangu nnyo olw'ebikolwa byo ebibi, olwokubanga onoobanga omusenguse.
alikulwaza olumbe olutawona olw'olukonvuba, okutuusa lwe lulikumalawo mu nsi gy'ogenda okuyingiramu ogirye.
alikulwaza akafuba, n'omusujja n'okubugujja. Era alikusindikira ebbugumu eryokya ennyo, n'ekyeya, n'ekitala, n'okugengewala; era binaakugobereranga okutuusa lw'olizikirira.
Eggulu waggulu w'omutwe gwo liribeera ng'ekikomo, n'ettaka wansi wo liriba ng'ekyuma.
alifuula enkuba y'omu nsi yo olufufugge, n'enfuufu yokka y'eneekuyiikiranga okuva waggulu mu bire, okutuusa lw'olizikirizibwa.
anaakulekeranga abalabe bo ne bakuwangulanga. Onoobalumbiranga mu kkubo limu, kyokka n'obadduka ng'obunye emiwabo mu makubo musanvu. Olifuuka kyakikangabwa mu maaso g'amawanga gonna ag'oku nsi.
Omulambo gwo gulifuuka mmere ya nnyonyi zonna ez'omu bbanga, n'eri ensolo ez'oku nsi, era tewaabeerengawo n'omu anaazigugobangako.
anaakulwazanga amayute g'e Misiri, n'ebizimba, n'amabwa, n'obuwere, by'otoowonyezebwenga.
anaakusuulanga eddalu, anaakuzibanga amaaso, n'okukutabulatabulanga mu ndowooza yo.

Mu ttuntu onoowammantanga ng'omuzibe w'amaaso abeera mu kizikiza obudde bwe bwonna. Buli ky'onookolanga onoolemwanga okukituukiriza; onoovumibwanga era onoobbibwanga buli kakedde, naye nga tewaabengawo akudduukirira.

Onooyogerezanga omukazi, n'osembereranga n'okumuwasa, naye omusajja omulala anaakumutwalangako n'asulanga naye. Oneezimbiranga ennyumba naye toogisulengamu. Oneesimbiranga ennimiro z'emizabbibu, naye toolyenga ku bibala byamu.

Sseddume zo zinattirwanga mu maaso go, naye toolyenga ku nnyama zaazo. Endogoyi zo zinabbirwanga mu maaso go, so tebaazikuddizenga. Endiga zo zinaaweebwanga abalabe bo, ne watabaawo adduukirira okuzikuddiza.
Batabani bo ne bawala bo banaagabibwanga mu baamawanga amalala ng'olaba; onoobanoonyanga buli lunaku okutuusa n'amaaso lwe ganaakumyukanga, naye nga tolina maanyi kubaako na kya kukola.
Ab'eggwanga ly'otomanyi banaalyanga ebibala by'ettaka lyo by'onoobanga weerimidde, toobengako na kya kukola wabula okutulugunyizibwanga buli kiseera.
Amaaso go bye ganaalabanga binaakusuulanga eddalu.
anaakulwazanga amayute ku maviivi ne ku magulu, agataayinzenga kuwonyezebwa, era ne gasaasaananga okuva mu bigere okutuuka ku kawumpo k'omutwe.
alikuleka, ggwe ne kabaka wo gw'onoobanga weerondedde n'otwalibwa mu ggwanga eddala ly'otowulirangako, ne bajjajjaabo lye bataamanya, n'oweererezanga eyo bakatonda abalala ab'emiti n'amayinja.
Olifuuka ekintu ekyesisiwaza, ekinaanyoomebwanga era ekinaasekererwanga mu mawanga gonna
Onoosiganga ensigo nnyingi mu nnimiro yo, kyokka onookungulangamu katono, kubanga enzige zinaalyanga ebibala byo byonna.
Onoosimbanga essamba z'emizabbibu n'ogisaliranga bulungi, naye toonywenga ku nvinnyo wadde okukuŋŋaanya ebibala bya zabbibu, kubanga ensiriŋŋanyi zinaabiryanga.
Onoobeeranga n'emiti egy'emizeeyituuni mu nsi yo yonna, naye togenda kukozesanga ku mafuta gaagyo, kubanga emizeeyituuni gyo ginaakunkumukanga ne gigwa wansi.
Olizaala abaana aboobulenzi n'aboobuwala, naye toosigalenga nabo, kubanga banaatwalibwanga mu busibe.
Enzige zineefuganga emiti gyo gyonna n'ebibala eby'omu ttaka lyo.
Bannamawanga b'onoobeeranga nabo bagenda kukulaakulananga balinnye waggulu okukusinganga, nga ggwe weeyongeranga kukka bussi wansi.
Banaakuwolanga, naye ggwe toobawolenga. Be banaabanga omutwe naye ggwe onoobanga mukira.
Ebikolimo ebyo byonna binaakujjiranga ne bikulondoolanga ne bikutuukako okutuusa lwe binaakuzikirizanga olw'obutagonderanga
Katonda wo, n'otokwatanga mateeka ge na biragiro bye, bye yakulagiranga.
Binaabeeranga mu ggwe ng'akabonero era ekyewuunyisa gy'oli n'eri bazzukulu bo emirembe gyonna.
Kubanga bwe wabeeranga obulungi n'ebintu ebingi, tewaweerezanga
Noolwekyo ng'oli mu njala ne mu nnyonta, ng'oli bwereere, ng'oli mwavu lunkupe, ojjanga kuweerezanga balabe bo,
b'anaakusindikiranga okulwana naawe! Anaakwambazanga mu bulago bwo ekikoligo eky'ekyuma okutuusa lw'alikuzikiririza ddala.
alikuleetera eggwanga eririva ewala ennyo, ku nkomerero y'ensi, ne likulumba, nga likukkako ng'empungu bw'eva waggulu n'ekka n'amaanyi ku nsi; liriba eggwanga ng'olulimi lwalyo tolutegeera.
Liribeera eggwanga erijjudde obukambwe mu maaso, eritassaamu kitiibwa bantu bakulu wadde okusaasira abato.

Balirya abaana b'ebisolo by'omu malundiro go, n'ebibala eby'omu ttaka lyo okutuusa lw'olizikirizibwa. Tebalikulekerawo ku mmere ya mpeke, wadde ku nvinnyo oba ku mafuta, wadde ku nnyana ez'ebiraalo byo, oba ku baana b'endiga ab'ebisibo byo, okutuusa lw'olizikirira.
Banaazingizanga ebibuga byo byonna mu nsi yo yonna okutuusa ebisenge ebiwanvu eby'ebigo bye weesiga lwe birigwa wansi. Banaazingizanga ebibuga byonna mu nsi yonna
Olw'okubonaabona abalabe bo kwe banaakutuusangako nga bakuzingizza, onoolyanga ebibala by'olubuto lwo, ennyama ya batabani bo ne bawala bo
Omusajja asingira ddala obuntubulamu era omuwombeefu mu mmwe, taasaasirenga na muganda we yennyini, oba mukyala we omwagalwa, oba abaana be abanaabanga bakyasigaddewo;
taawengako n'omu ku nnyama y'abaana be b'anaabanga alya. Kubanga nga takyalina ky'asigazza kyonna mu kubonaabona okungi omulabe wo kw'anaabanga akutuusizzaako ng'akuzingirizza mu bibuga byo byonna.
Omukazi asinga obuntubulamu n'eggonjebwa mu mmwe, nga mwenaanyi nnyo, ataŋŋanga na kulinnyisa kigere kye ku ttaka nga kyereere, taamanyisenga bba omwagalwa, wadde mutabani we, oba muwala we,

ku mwana gw'anaabanga y'akazaala ow'omu lubuto lwe, n'abaana b'anaazaalanga. Kubanga anaabanga ategese okubalyanga mu nkukutu olw'okubulwako ekyokulya ekirala mu biseera eby'okuzingizibwa era eby'ennaku enzibu ennyo, omulabe wo by'anaabanga akutuusizzaako mu bibuga byo.
Bw'otoogonderenga na bwegendereza ebigambo byonna ebiri mu mateeka gano, ebiwandiikiddwa mu kitabo kino, n'ototya era n'otossaamu kitiibwa erinnya lino ery'ettendo era ery'entiisa, eriyitibwa:
anaakuweerezanga endwadde enkambwe ennyo, eri ggwe n'eri ezzadde lyo; endwadde ez'olutentezi era enkambwe ennyo ez'olukonvuba.
Anaakuleeteranga endwadde zonna ez'e Misiri, ezaakutiisa ennyo, ne zikwezingangako.
anaakuleeteranga endwadde eza buli ngeri, n'ebibonoobono ebitawandiikiddwa mu Kitabo eky'Amateeka gano, okutuusa lw'olizikirizibwa.
Era mulisigala ng'omuwendo gwammwe gusse nnyo wansi, songa mwali ng'emmunyeenye ez'oku ggulu olw'obungi bwammwe; lwa kubanga tewagonderanga ddoboozi lya
okubagaggawazanga n'okubaazanga mweyongerenga obungi, bwe kityo kinaamusanyusanga okubaavuwazanga n'okubazikirizanga. Olisimbulwa n'oggibwa mu nsi gy'ogenda okuyingira okugirya.

anaakusaasaanyanga mu mawanga gonna, okutandikira ku ludda olumu olw'ensi gy'etandikira, okutuuka ku ludda olulala gy'ekoma. Eyo gy'onoosinzizanga bakatonda abalala abakolebwa mu miti ne mu mayinja, ggwe ne bajjajjaabo be mutamanyangako.
Mu mawanga ago togenda kuweereraweererangayo wadde ebigere byo okufunirangayo ekiwummulo. Eyo,
anaakuweerangayo omutima ogujugumira, n'amaaso agaagala okuziba olw'okujulirira, n'emmeeme eweddemu essuubi.
Onoobanga mu kubuusabuusa buli kaseera, ng'ojjudde okutya emisana n'ekiro, ng'obulamu bwo tobwekakasa.
Mu makya onoogambanga nti, "Singa nno bubadde kiro!" Ate ekiro ng'ogamba nti, "Singa nno bubadde makya!" olw'okutya okunajjulanga mu mutima gwo, n'ebyo amaaso go bye ganaalabanga.
anaakuzzangayo mu Misiri mu kyombo, ku lugendo lwe nakugaana okuddayo okutambula. Ng'oli eyo oneewangayo weetunde ng'omuddu omusajja oba ng'omuddu omukazi, naye toofunengayo muntu n'omu akugula.

items.text: Katonda gye yalagira Musa okukola n'abaana ba Isirayiri nga bali mu nsi ya Mowaabu, ng'egattibwa ku ndagaano gye yali akoze nabo ku Kolebu.
Awo Musa n'ayita Abayisirayiri bonna n'abagamba nti, Mwalaba n'amaaso gammwe ebyo byonna
Katonda bye yakolera mu nsi y'e Misiri ku Falaawo ne ku bakungu be, ne ku nsi ye yonna.
Walaba n'amaaso go ebigezo ebinene, n'obubonero obw'ebyamagero, n'ebyewuunyisa ebikulu.
Naye n'okutuusa ku lunaku lwa leero
tabawanga mutima ogutegeera, oba amaaso agalaba, oba amatu agawulira.
Bwe nabakulembera okumala emyaka amakumi ana mu ddungu engoye zammwe tezaakaddiwako, n'engatto y'omu kigere kyo teyakaddiwa.
Temwalya ku mugaati wadde okunywa ku nvinnyo, oba ku kyokunywa ekirala kyonna ekitamiiza. Ekyo nakikola mulyoke mumanye nga nze
Bwe mwatuuka mu kifo kino, Sikoni kabaka w'e Kesuboni, ne Ogi kabaka w'e Basani, ne basituka okutulwanyisa, naye ne tubawangula.
Twatwala ensi yaabwe, ne tugigabira Abalewubeeni, n'Abagaadi, n'ekitundu ky'ekika eky'Abamanase, okuba obutaka bwabwe obw'ensikirano.
Noolwekyo mukwatenga ebigambo by'endagaano eno n'obwegendereza, mulyoke muwangulenga mu buli kimu kye munaakolanga.
Mukuŋŋaanye wano leero mwenna mu maaso ga
Katonda wammwe, nga muli n'abakulembeze b'ebika byammwe, n'abakulu bammwe abakulembeze, n'abafuzi bammwe, n'abasajja bonna aba Isirayiri,
n'abaana bammwe abato, ne bakazi bammwe, ne munnaggwanga asula awamu naawe mu lusiisira lwo, okukutyabira enku, n'okukukimira amazzi.
alyoke akukakase ng'akunyweza leero okubeeranga eggwanga lye, naye nga ye Katonda wo, nga bwe yakusuubiza, era nga bwe yalayirira bakadde bo: Ibulayimu ne Isaaka.
Endagaano eno gye nkola, ng'eriko n'ekirayiro kyayo,
sigikola nammwe abayimiridde wano naffe leero mwekka, wabula ngikola wamu n'oyo atali wano naffe leero.
Mujjukira bulungi nga bwe twali mu nsi y'e Misiri, ne bwe twajjanga tuyita wakati mu mawanga okutuukira ddala wano.
Mwalabanga ebintu eby'ekikaafiiri, nga mwe mwalinga ebifaananyi ebibajje mu miti n'ebiwoole mu mayinja ne mu ffeeza ne mu zaabu.
Mukakasize ddala leero nga mu maka gammwe oba mu bika byammwe temulinaamu musajja oba mukazi n'omu akyamizza omutima gwe okuva ku
Katonda waffe agende asinze bakatonda bali abalala abamawanga ago. Mukakasize ddala nga mu mmwe temuliimu kikolo okuyinza okukula obutwa obw'engeri eyo obukaawa ng'omususa.

Omuntu ow'engeri ng'eyo ng'awulidde ebigambo eby'ekikolimo kino n'amala yeeyibaala, ne yeetukuza ku bubwe yekka, n'alowooza munda ye nti, "Nzija kubeera bulungi newaakubadde nga mmaliridde okukwata ekkubo eryange ery'obujeemu," ekyo kinaaletanga akacwano ku ttaka erinnyogovu obulungi ne ku kkalu.
n'ekiruyi kye binaabuubuukiranga ku muntu oyo. Ebikolimo byonna ebiwandiikiddwa mu Kitabo kino binaamukkangako, era

items.text: Emikisa n'ebikolimo ebyo byonna bye nkutegeezezza, bwe binaakutuukangako n'ojjukiranga ng'oli eyo mu nsi ezo zonna
Katonda wo, n'omugonderanga, n'abaana bo bonna, n'omutima gwo gwonna, n'emmeeme yo yonna, nga bwe nkulagira leero,
Katonda wo anaakusaasiranga n'akuzza mu mbeera yo ennungi eneekweyagazanga, ng'akuwumbyewumbye okukuggya eyo gy'anaabanga akusaasaanyirizza.
Newaakubadde onoobanga owaŋŋangusiriddwa mu nsi esinga okubeera ey'ewala ennyo wansi w'eggulu,
Katonda wo anaakukomyangawo mu nsi bajjajjaabo gye baafuna, naawe onoogifunanga. Alikugaggawaza era n'akwaza nnyo okukira bajjajjaabo.
Katonda wo alikomola omutima gwo, n'omutima gwa bazzukulu bo, bw'otyo oyagalanga
Katonda wo n'omutima gwo gwonna, n'emmeeme yo yonna, olyoke obeerenga omulamu.
Katonda wo aliteeka ebikolimo ebyo byonna ku balabe bo ne ku abo abanaakuyigganyanga.
Katonda ng'okwata amateeka ge, ge nkulagira leero.
Katonda wo alikugaggawaza mu buli kintu kyonna ky'onookolanga, mu bibala eby'omubiri gwo, ne mu bibala eby'ebisolo byo, ne mu bibala eby'ettaka lyo.
alisanyuka nnyo okukugaggawazanga n'obeeranga bulungi, nga bwe kyamusanyusanga okugaggawazanga bajjajjaabo,
Katonda wo, n'okwatanga amateeka ge n'ebiragiro bye ebiwandiikiddwa mu Kitabo eky'Amateeka kino, n'odda eri
Katonda wo n'omukyukiranga n'omutima gwo gwonna, n'emmeeme yo yonna.
Etteeka lye nkulagira leero terisaana kukukaluubirira, kubanga terikuli wala nnyo.
Teriri mu ggulu, n'okugamba ne kikugambisa nti, "Ani anaatulinnyirayo mu ggulu n'atulireeterayo tulyoke tuliwulire tuligonderenga?"
So teriri mitala wa nnyanja, olyoke ogambe nti, "Ani anaatusomokera ennyanja, alituleetere tuwulire bye ligamba, tuligondere?"
Nedda, ekigambo kiri kumpi ddala ne w'oli, kiri mu kamwa ko ne mu mutima gwo, olyoke okigondere.
Kale laba, olwa leero ntadde mu maaso go obulamu n'okufa.
Katonda wo, okutambuliranga mu makubo ge, awamu n'okukwatanga amateeka ge n'okugobereranga ebiragiro bye byonna. Bw'onookolanga bw'otyo ojjanga kuba mulamu era oyale, ne
Katonda wo anaakuwanga omukisa ng'oli mu nsi gy'oyingira okugifuna.
Naye omutima gwo bwe gunaakyamanga n'otowulira, era bw'onoosendebwasendebwanga okusinzanga bakatonda abalala n'okubaweerezanga,
mbalangirira leero nti, Mugenda kuzikirizibwa; era temuliwangaala mu nsi gy'ogenda okusomokera omugga Yoludaani okugiyingira okugifuna.

Ku lunaku lwa leero nkoowoola eggulu n'ensi nga be bajulirwa bange, ku mmwe, abategedde nga ntadde mu maaso gammwe, obulamu n'okufa; n'emikisa n'ebikolimo. Kale nno londawo obulamu, olyoke obeerenga mulamu, ggwe n'ezzadde lyo:
Katonda wo, ng'owuliranga eddoboozi lye, era nga weekwatira ddala ku ye. Kubanga
bwe bulamu bwo n'okuwangaala; alyoke akuwenga emyaka mingi mu nsi
gye yalayirira okugiwa bajjajjaabo: Ibulayimu, ne Isaaka, ne Yakobo.
